jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

**A Few Things About Us**

Welcome to Diverzify+! We are the largest and most respected commercial flooring installation service company in the industry, with 60+ locations across the U.S. and a team of nearly 2,300. Our innovative vision and partnerships with top companies set us apart. Working with us means joining a fun and hardworking team. We offer competitive pay and total rewards (Medical, Dental, Vision, Telemedical, Mental Health, Prescriptions, HSA/FSA, Life and AD&D, and 401k Company Match). Come join us and be a part of something amazing!

**Job Summary**

At Diverzify+ and our Family of Brands, our Project Coordinators work closely with Project Managers to plan and execute flooring projects from start to finish. Responsibilities include creating action plans, scheduling resources, managing budgets and timelines, coordinating tasks, handling risk management, and maintaining project documentation. They ensure projects meet quality standards, stay on budget, and deliver customer satisfaction through effective communication and time management.

Requirements:

**Job Responsibilities**

* Manage paperwork flow for Account Managers' or Executives' projects, verifying contracts, POs, and change orders for accuracy
* Build customer relations through timely document return and create routing sheets to track paperwork
* Communicate with suppliers about product availability and place/track material orders
* Make freight arrangements for cost-effective product shipments
* Perform timely follow-ups on shipments and track multiple deliveries
* Distribute bi-monthly Salesperson billing summary sheets for customer billing
* Maintain project documentation in job folders and the computer system
* Prepare monthly AIA-type billing and ensure job folders support payment verifications and final invoicing
* Review change orders, verify billing documents, and submit for client approval
* Complete accurate billing and follow up with clients for payment verification
* Prepare necessary project close-outs at project completion.

**Qualifications**

* Proven work experience in a Construction Administration role.
* Experience in project management, from conception to delivery.
* An ability to prepare and interpret flowcharts, schedules, and step-by-step action plans.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Microsoft Planner.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* BSc in Business Administration or related field
* Experience as a Project Coordinator role or similar within the construction industry.
* Familiarity with risk management and quality assurance control
* Hands-on experience with project management tools
* PMP / PRINCE2 certification

*We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview:

As a ***Project Coordinator*** at Schuff Steel, You will assist in managing the flow of technical information between the Schuff Steel Project Management team, customers, and subcontractors and vendors, while developing critical relationships with internal and external clients, through verbal and written communication. They collaborate with other departments to ensure all aspects of each project are executed smoothly. Schuff PC’s have worked on some of the most amazing building structures in North America. Please consider joining our dynamic Project Management Team.

Responsibilities:

**Job Overview**

* Reviews design drawings for accuracy and completeness, and coordinates resolution of discrepancies and/or missing information with customers, design team, other trades, detailing, shop, & field as may be necessary.
* Coordinates project sequencing and basic detailing job setup, including advance bills and shop and erection drawings.
* Provides technical instructions and guidance to steel detailers in preparing shop drawings per project requirements and standards.
* Monitors project schedules regarding submittals, approvals, and shop fabrication releases. Identify and communicate possible delays or problems to project management team.
* Organize detailing RFI process through formal RFI to customer and informal RFI’s with the engineer, architect, and general contractor. Facilitates and fulfills other documentation efforts and duties and as may be required.
* Distribute and route drawings. Partner with Document Control to avoid delays and maintain logs.
* Act as a liaison between shop, field, and detailers to resolve fabrication and erection difficulties.
* Maintains daily communication with Project Manager, Sr. Project Manager or Vice President on progress of areas of responsibility.
* Assists the Project Management Team in achieving successful project results.
* Coordinates the detailing efforts of various common subcontractors.
* Serve as a direct link between Detailers, Project Managers, and other production departments, and customer, other contractors, and Design Team as may be required.

Qualifications:

**Education/Training**

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Associates degree or training from an approved and accredited technical school in engineering or detailing/drafting is highly preferred.
* A Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in CM, Structural/Civil Engineering, or other technical area may substitute for required experience.

**Work Experience**

* At least five (5) years related experience in the coordination of structural steel projects. Detailing experience highly preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Ability to read and interpret shop and design drawings.
* General understanding and knowledge of basic drafting skills
* 3D modeling software/Tekla practices, fabrication and erection standards, standard technical terminology, common structural steel practices, and drafting room procedures.

**Software & Technology**

  

* MS Windows 10, MS Office 365; Office Word, Excel, and Outlook; Contract Manager, Primavera Scheduling, Fabtrol and Tekla system. Bluebeam applications.

**Work Environment**

* The position may require frequent air/road travel as needed and required. A clean driving record will be required due to required road travel.
* A current and valid driver’s license and proof of acceptable insurance is required.
* This position is generally indoors in a climate-controlled office. However, frequent visitations to the outdoor plant facilities and project sites may be required.
* Reasonable accommodations will be made upon request for those who have disabilities that qualify under the American with Disabilities Act.

At Schuff Steel, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. Our team environment is based on respect, effective communications, and accountability. We believe employees should have great working conditions along with opportunities to grow and develop. We proudly promote a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone has a chance to be successful. Schuff Steel is an Equal Opportunity Employer with an Affirmative Action Plan. We value Diversity.

Rated by ENR as a leading builder in America, please consider joining our elite organization today. Apply directly. No agencies #LI-KF1

Pay Range: The anticipated compensation for this position is USD $65,000.00/Yr. - USD $90,000.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

jobs.title: Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Community Clinic Association of Los Angeles County (CCALAC) is a non-profit membership organization that provides a wide variety of essential services to community health centers that serve the Los Angeles region. Founded in 1994, CCALAC’s mission is to “empower health centers to remain at the forefront of health care transformation. We forge partnerships, foster innovation, promote health equity, and advocate for the communities they serve.”

CCALAC represents 68 community health center organizations that provide comprehensive primary, dental and behavioral health services throughout Los Angeles County. Health centers in Los Angeles serve 2.18 million patients annually regardless of ability to pay. These organizations include private, non-profit, Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), and community health centers.

**JOB SUMMARY**

Reporting to the Communications Manager, the Communications Coordinator is responsible for activities that support CCALAC’s communications strategy. This includes media relations, internal and external communications development, event promotion and digital media. The Communications Coordinator is responsible for developing and implementing media and social media strategies to advance the mission and vision of CCALAC members and further the advocacy and public relations goals of the organization.

**JOB DUTIES**

**COMMUNICATIONS**

* Support the Communications Manager with CCALAC’s communications strategy.
* Collaborate with the Communications Manager to develop materials for public relations (e.g., press releases, statements, op-ed articles, etc.).
* Develop and maintain media lists.
* Contribute ideas to, draft copy for, and design member newsletter.
* Coordinate networking and best practice sharing among member communications and marketing leads in collaboration with Communications Manager.

**BRANDING AND DESIGN**

* Support the organization’s external image and branding by ensuring adherence of all CCALAC communication materials to the organization’s style guide. This includes maintaining the style guide, and supporting CCALAC divisions and individuals with development and edits of internal and external communication materials.
* Create graphics, flyers, PowerPoints and branded items using tools like Canva or Google Slides.

**DIGITAL MEDIA**

* Create original social media content (photos, graphics and video) to highlight CCALAC and member achievements, events and critical issues impacting health centers and their patients.
* Monitor social media accounts (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn) and respond to comments and inquiries.
* Collaborate with Communications Manager to engage key audiences and partners and to foster relationships online.
* Organize digital media library and develop a catalogue system for content.
* Periodically visit member clinics and attend member events across Los Angeles to take photos and videos.
* Create analytics reports.
* Identify emerging social media trends and make recommendations on if/how CCALAC should incorporate them into the organization’s strategy.
* Assist with writing and updating website content.

**EVENTS**

* Design, create and edit invitations, flyers, posters and other print and electronic materials.
* Promote events via marketing emails, social media, targeted outreach and other methods.
* Photograph and record events as needed.
* Assist in the promotion and coordination of activities for the annual National Health Center Week.

**OTHER PROJECTS**

Assist the Senior Director of Government and External Affairs and CCALAC leadership with other duties as assigned to advance the organization’s mission and vision.

**MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS**

1. Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communication, or digital media related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

2. A minimum of three years of related communications experience.

3. Ability to maintain confidential information.

4. Knowledge of or familiarity with health care, health policy issues, and/or Los Angeles County health care system preferred.

5. Ability to work as part of a team as well as independently with minimal supervision.

6. Strong reading comprehension, oral, and written skills required.

7. Strong skills with Excel & MS Office Suite required.

8. Ability to draft content that is succinct, grammatically correct and error free.

9. Experience presenting information in written, graphic, and verbal formats.

10. Experience with social media, branding, marketing, and communications strategy.

11. Experience creating materials including simple promotional flyers, infographics, digital graphics, presentations, memos, issue briefs, and reports.

12. Familiarity with software for document and materials creation (e.g., PowerPoint, Adobe CC, Canva, Google Slides, etc.), and making simple photo edits (e.g., cropping, brightening).

13. Experience/familiarity with email marketing platforms.

14. Follow directions and respond positively to constructive feedback.

15. Manage time effectively and pay excellent attention to detail.

16. Comfortable advocating for or against policies that affect community health centers.

17. Flexibility to adapt as priorities shift/change.

18. Develop and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues, organization leadership and external partners.

19. Strong sense of accountability to community.

**LOCATION:** Candidates must reside in one of the following Southern California counties: Los Angeles, Ventura, Santa Barbara, Kern, San Luis Obispo, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, San Diego and Imperial.

jobs.description:
**About GFFG:**

GFFG is a Seoul-based hospitality group behind some of Korea’s most beloved food and beverage brands, including Cafe Knotted and Hojokban. GFFG America Inc. brings these concepts to the U.S. Cafe Knotted, a dessert cafe and bakery from Seoul, is open in Los Angeles at Westfield Century City and in the Arts District. Hojokban, the Korean restaurant founded in Seoul’s Cheongdam neighborhood, opened in New York City in 2023 and in Los Angeles’ Arts District in November 2025. Learn more at www.gffg.co.kr.

**Position Overview:**

GFFG America is looking for a creative, detail-oriented Graphic Designer & Social Media Coordinator to shape the visual identity and online presence of our brands in the U.S. This role sits within our Brand Strategy team and works across Cafe Knotted and Hojokban, producing design assets, creating and publishing social content, managing our online reputation, and building relationships with creators and media.

This is an on-site position based in Los Angeles, typically working out of our Arts District locations with regular visits to Cafe Knotted Westfield Century City. The ideal candidate is a strong designer who is equally comfortable behind a camera, inside a content calendar, and in a guest review inbox.

**Schedule:**

The typical schedule is Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm. Hours are flexible and will shift as needed to capture content and support events, including some evenings and weekends.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

*Graphic Design & Print Production:*

* Produce polished, on-brand design assets using Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) across social media, web, advertising, menus, signage, and packaging
* Apply strong typography, color, layout, and composition to elevate all marketing materials
* Maintain and enforce brand guidelines for each brand, ensuring visual consistency across every touchpoint
* Manage updates to menus, promotional materials, website visuals, and in-store displays so guest-facing information is always accurate
* Adapt designs across digital, print, packaging, multimedia, and experiential formats
* Organize and maintain a structured digital asset library
* Coordinate with external vendors and printers on menu printing, signage, and collateral to ensure production quality and on-time delivery

*Social Media & Content Creation:*

* Lead the management and curation of all Company social channels (Cafe Knotted, Hojokban) on Instagram and TikTok, keeping them visually cohesive, consistently updated, and aligned with brand strategy
* Plan, create, schedule, and publish 2–3 posts and Reels per week per brand, maintaining a content calendar at least one week ahead
* Capture and edit photo and video content on-site at our locations for social, web, and marketing use
* Monitor DMs, comments, and tagged content daily; engage with the community and repost guest content
* Analyze social performance and engagement data to inform content strategy and improve reach
* Stay current with design trends, platform changes, and hospitality marketing best practices

*Reputation Management:*

* Monitor and respond to guest reviews on Google, Yelp, OpenTable, and DoorDash promptly and professionally, in a voice consistent with each brand and our hospitality standards
* Maintain and optimize business listings (Google Business Profile, Yelp, OpenTable, DoorDash) for accuracy, imagery, and completeness
* Track review trends and surface recurring guest feedback to on-site leadership

*Website, SEO / GEO & Digital Marketing:*

* Maintain website content and visuals for both brands
* Support search engine optimization (SEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) efforts so our brands are discoverable on Google, Maps, and AI-driven search
* Set up and manage Google Ads campaigns, monitoring performance and adjusting as needed

*Creator & Media Outreach:*

* Identify, evaluate, and reach out to local creators, influencers, and media who fit each brand
* Manage gifted and paid collaborations end to end — outreach, negotiation and budget approval, scheduling visits with on-site teams, and tracking posted content and results
* Assist in organizing and executing special marketing events, campaigns, and collaborations

**Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of graphic design experience (hospitality, food & beverage, or lifestyle brands preferred)
* Strong portfolio demonstrating brand-driven design across digital and print
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign); experience with Figma, Canva, CapCut, or Premiere a plus
* Hands-on experience managing brand social media accounts (Instagram, TikTok) including content creation, scheduling, and analytics
* Photography and short-form video skills, including RAW photo editing; comfortable shooting on-site with a phone and/or camera
* Familiarity with Google Business Profile, Yelp, OpenTable, and DoorDash merchant tools, Google Ads, and basic SEO principles
* Strong written communication skills; able to write in multiple brand voices
* Highly organized, able to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
* Korean language proficiency strongly preferred but not required; familiarity with Korean food culture a plus
* Must have reliable transportation for travel between Los Angeles locations

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* $55,000–$70,000 annual salary, based on experience

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**This position is based full-time in our corporate office located at 9200 Sunset Blvd., West Hollywood, CA 90069.** ***Relocation assistance is not available for this role.***

Description:

**Innovative Dining Group (IDG) is seeking a detail-oriented and creative MARKETING COORDINATOR to support marketing initiatives across our growing portfolio of restaurants.**This hands-on role will help keep our digital presence accurate and up to date, support social media and content development, conduct competitive and industry research, and assist with restaurant-level marketing needs. The ideal candidate is curious, organized, resourceful, and excited to learn, with a strong interest in hospitality, marketing, social media, and emerging technology.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include but are not limited to:

**Digital + Website**

* Conduct regular audits of all brand and restaurant websites to ensure hours, menus, reservation links, contact information, private dining details, photography, and copy are accurate and up to date.
* Audit Google Business Profiles for accuracy, including hours, categories, links, photos, menus, and other key business information.
* Ensure restaurant names and business information are consistent across Google, Apple Maps, Yelp, Tripadvisor, and other relevant platforms.
* Conduct regular Yelp and Tripadvisor audits to identify inaccurate information, outdated imagery, or other content requiring updates.
* Test SevenRooms reservation links across websites, social media, Google, and other customer-facing channels to ensure links are active and functioning properly.
* Review the mobile experience across all websites and flag formatting, functionality, or content issues.
* Set up and maintain enterprise Canva accounts across locations and provide basic training and support to GMs as needed.
* Audit restaurant menus across digital channels to ensure they accurately match current approved menu PDFs.
* Audit email signup forms across all websites to ensure they are functioning properly and capturing customer information as intended.

**Social Media**

* Conduct regular social media audits to ensure account information, links, contact details, and other profile information are accurate and up to date.
* Monitor Instagram and TikTok for trending sounds, formats, and content opportunities relevant to BOA, Sushi Roku, Katana, and other IDG brands.
* Identify and organize relevant user-generated content, including screenshots and creator handles, for potential reposting by individual restaurant locations.
* Research emerging restaurant content trends and formats and present 5–10 relevant content ideas each week.

**Restaurant + Operations Marketing**

* Maintain an accurate inventory of restaurant uniforms, including updating tracking spreadsheets and organizing uniform storage areas.
* Develop and maintain a master reference of restaurant hours, happy hours, brunch and lunch offerings, private dining capacities, parking and valet information, and other key guest-facing details.
* Assist Marketing Manager with planning, production, organization, and coordination of the Holiday Cookbook.
* Support restaurant-level marketing needs and projects as assigned, helping ensure brand standards and marketing materials are consistently executed across locations.

**Competitive Research + Industry Trends**

* Conduct ongoing competitive research using Bluenote and other relevant sources to identify trends and opportunities across the restaurant and hospitality industry.
* Monitor competitors and relevant brands for new restaurant openings, launches, collaborations, events, promotions, partnerships, and creative marketing initiatives.
* Prepare a weekly Friday recap highlighting the most relevant trends, ideas, and competitive activity for the marketing team.

**Technology + AI**

* Research emerging marketing technology, AI tools, platforms, and resources that could improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Marketing department.
* Assist in auditing recurring marketing tasks and workflows to identify redundancies, opportunities for automation, and areas where AI can improve efficiency.
* Research and recommend AI tools that can support creative production, reporting, PR and copywriting, content development, and project management.
* Help establish and maintain approved AI tools, prompts, standard operating procedures, and training resources for the Marketing department.
* Evaluate tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Munch, and other emerging platforms for potential use in marketing campaigns, content creation, reporting, and workflow automation.
* Assist Marketing Manager in improving visibility and organization of social media content planning and execution at the restaurant level.

Requirements:

**QUALIFICATIONS**:

* 1–2 years of marketing, communications, social media, or related experience preferred; internships and relevant college experience welcome.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Strong interest in hospitality, restaurants, social media, and digital marketing.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable learning new technology and digital platforms; Canva experience preferred.
* Creative, curious, and proactive, with a willingness to learn and bring new ideas to the team.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Willingness to travel to IDG restaurants and support projects in the field as needed.

Pay: $28.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator - Women's Health Institute
jobs.description:
**Description**

Administrative Coordinator at Providence Saint John’s Health Center in Santa Monica, CA. This position is Full Time and will work 8-hour, Day shifts.

Join Providence Saint John's Health Center, recognized as one of the best regional hospitals in 17 types of care by U.S. News & World Report and honored by Newsweek and Healthgrades for exceptional clinical quality. Be a part of our distinguished team dedicated to excellence in patient care. We are on the Magnet journey, and we were just awarded a 5-star rating for quality, safe care from the Centers of Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).

Under the general supervision of the department manager, this position will coordinate administrative functions of the outpatient rehabilitation department, assist with scheduling of patients and insurance verification, communicate relevant information to and from physician offices, perform data entry, as well as create and organize patient charts.

Providence caregivers are not simply valued – they’re invaluable. Join our team at Saint Johns Health Center and thrive in our culture of patient-focused, whole-person care built on understanding, commitment, and mutual respect. Your voice matters here, because we know that to inspire and retain the best people, we must empower them.

**Required Qualifications:**

* H.S. Diploma or GED Or

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1 year Directly related experience.

**Why Join Providence?**

Our best-in-class benefits are uniquely designed to support you and your family in staying well, growing professionally, and achieving financial security. We take care of you, so you can focus on delivering our Mission of caring for everyone, especially the most vulnerable in our communities.

**About Providence**

At Providence, our strength lies in Our Promise of “Know me, care for me, ease my way.” Working at our family of organizations means that regardless of your role, we’ll walk alongside you in your career, supporting you so you can support others. We provide best-in-class benefits and we foster an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued, and everyone is essential, heard and respected. Together, our 120,000 caregivers (all employees) serve in over 50 hospitals, over 1,000 clinics and a full range of health and social services across Alaska, California, Montana, New Mexico, Oregon, Texas and Washington. As a comprehensive health care organization, we are serving more people, advancing best practices and continuing our more than 100-year tradition of serving the poor and vulnerable.

Posted are the minimum and the maximum wage rates on the wage range for this position. The successful candidate's placement on the wage range for this position will be determined based upon relevant job experience and other applicable factors. These amounts are the base pay range; additional compensation may be available for this role, such as shift differentials, standby/on-call, overtime, premiums, extra shift incentives, or bonus opportunities.

Providence offers a comprehensive benefits package including a retirement 401(k) Savings Plan with employer matching, health care benefits (medical, dental, vision), life insurance, disability insurance, time off benefits (paid parental leave, vacations, holidays, health issues), voluntary benefits, well-being resources and much more. Learn more at providence.jobs/benefits.

Applicants in the Unincorporated County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Unincorporated Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

**About the Team**

The Sisters of Providence and Sisters of St. Joseph of Orange have deep roots in California, bringing health care and education to communities from the redwood forests to the beach shores of Orange county - and everywhere in between. Since 1977, Cinelease has supported the film and television industry with lighting and grip equipment, production services, and studio facilities. Our reputation is built on exceptional service, industry expertise, and a commitment to helping productions succeed.

The Marketing & Social Media Manager will manage Cinelease’s social media presence, develop campaign concepts, and create marketing assets that strengthen

brand awareness and customer engagement across our divisions. Working closely with marketing leadership, project directors, and internal teams, you will

translate business priorities into clear messaging and effective creative work. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys both developing ideas and bringing them to life.

An initial priority will be evaluating Cinelease’s social media channels and implementing a coordinated plan to improve content quality, brand consistency, and audience engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Social Media Management**

* Own the social content calendar and day-to-day publishing, aligning content with company initiatives, services, events, and relevant industry conversations.
* Write and publish content tailored to each platform, manage community engagement, and connect customer inquiries with the appropriate teams.
* Monitor channel performance, audience insights, and emerging trends to recommend improvements and report on reach, engagement, website traffic, and

relevant inquiries.

**Creative Content & Campaign Management**

* Develop campaign concepts and stories that showcase Cinelease’s people, equipment, facilities, and services while supporting the broader brand strategy.
* Capture and edit photography and video, and create graphics for digital campaigns, sales materials, merchandise, and internal communications.
* Manage assigned creative projects from concept through publication, collaborating with internal teams and outside partners to coordinate priorities,

timelines, feedback, and approvals.

* Maintain consistent messaging and design across divisions and channels, including creative support for website updates and customer-facing digital

initiatives.

* Organize creative assets and ensure published content is accurate, approved, and respectful of usage permissions and production confidentiality.

* At least three years of relevant experience in marketing, social media management, creative content production, or a related field.
* A portfolio demonstrating graphic design, photography, video editing, and social media content, with a clear explanation of your contribution.
* Experience managing business social media accounts and using publishing and analytics tools to guide improvements.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud or comparable design, photo editing, and video production tools.
* Practical knowledge of camera operation, lighting, audio capture, composition, and editing.
* Strong writing, proofreading, organization, and project management skills.
* Sound creative judgment and the ability to manage overlapping deadlines, incorporate feedback, and collaborate across teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with film and television production, equipment rental, studio operations, or related business-to-business services.
* Experience supporting multiple locations, divisions, or brands.
* Motion graphics, basic animation, paid social campaign support, or website content management experience.
* A degree in marketing, communications, graphic design, film, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success means a consistent, engaging social media presence; creative work that clearly communicates Cinelease’s capabilities; reliable campaign delivery; and measurable improvements in audience engagement and relevant customer interest. You will help establish an efficient creative workflow that supports planned campaigns and timely opportunities.

**Why Cinelease**

This role offers the opportunity to shape how Cinelease’s people, expertise, and services are represented across its marketing channels. You will collaborate with teams supporting film and television production and see your ideas become content used throughout the business.

* Commission not earned on sales tax, refunds, or separately charged delivery/installation
* Commission applies to sales generated by the representative

**Location: Los Angeles (Hybrid in-person / remote)**

KEITA isa small Los Angeles-based furniture design and fabrication studio looking for a **motivated, personable, and organized** Fine Furniture Sales Representative to help grow a network of clients, interior designers, architects, galleries, showrooms, and trade partners.

This is a relationship-driven sales role for someone who enjoys meeting people, initiating conversations, and building lasting professional relationships. We’re looking for someone who is self-directed, outgoing, and comfortable creating sales opportunities through outreach and follow-up. The ideal candidate has a **strong appreciation for design, craftsmanship, and quality, and is excited to represent a small studio creating distinctive, one-of-a-kind furniture.** Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, along with the ability to speak confidently with both design professionals and private clients. This role requires someone who can manage multiple leads and relationships, stay organized, follow through consistently, and remain persistent through longer sales cycles.

The role will focus on developing new business, building relationships within the design community, generating sales of existing pieces, and initiating custom furniture projects. An interest in KEITA’s design philosophy and commitment to locally made, sustainable furniture is important.

**What You'll Do**

You’ll develop sales opportunities and build relationships with interior designers, architects, design firms, galleries, showrooms, collectors, and private clients. This includes cold outreach, attending design events and industry gatherings, introducing KEITA to potential trade partners, and maintaining relationships through consistent communication and follow-up. You’ll guide clients through product selection, pricing, and purchasing, while identifying opportunities for custom furniture comissions. **You’ll work closely with KEITA’s design and fabrication team to communicate client needs, coordinate pricing and timelines, and support communications from initial inquiry through sale and delivery.** You’ll also maintain organized records, and coordinate with shop management on product availability, orders, and delivery or installation.

Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, along with the ability to speak confidently with both design professionals and private clients. The right person for this position has a strong appreciation for **design, aesthetics, craftsmanship, and quality**, and is able to communicate the value of thoughtfully made, one-of-a-kind furniture.

**Preferred / Bonus Experience**

* Experience in high-end furniture, interior design, architecture, art, luxury goods, or a related field
* Experience in relationship-based sales, business development, cold outreach, or account management
* Familiarity with selling through interior designers and other trade channels
* Experience with custom furniture, furniture specification, or design projects
* Existing relationships within the Los Angeles design, architecture, furniture, art, or luxury residential community
* An established network of interior designers, architects, design firms, galleries, or showrooms
* Familiarity with CRM systems, sales tracking, or other organizational tools

**What Success Looks Like**

Success means expanding KEITA’s network, and creating new opportunities for the studio by building lasting relationships, generating qualified sales opportunities, and converting those opportunities into furniture sales and projects.

Pay: $35.00 - $40.00 per hour

jobs.description:
Pickleball TV is looking for a Social Media Manager to own its Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube channels, with YouTube a key priority across both long-form and Shorts. This is a hands-on role: you'll set the strategy for each platform, concept and create the content, run day-to-day publishing, and lead a production coordinator supports video edits. You'll also travel to select pickleball events to capture content on site and build relationships across the pickleball community.

This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

**In this role, you willâ€¦**

**Develop Strategy**

* Build and own a distinct strategy for each channel â€” audience, content pillars, formats, cadence, and growth tactics.
* Set quarterly plans for each platform and plan for events, programming moments, campaigns, and sponsor deliverables.
* Identify growth opportunities, such as new series, formats, and creator collaborations, and bring recommendations to the Head of Social.
* Track performance, report weekly and monthly to the Head of Social, and adjust based on what's working.
  

**Create & Publish Content**

* Concept and create social-first content and series: player features, highlights, skills content, trends, and behind-the-scenes.
* Shoot, write, and edit short-form video; turn Pickleball TV programming into platform-native clips.
* Own the content calendar across all three channels and publish daily, including captions, sound, hashtags, and platform-native styling.
* Run live publishing during key events and QA every post for accuracy and brand voice.
  

**Manage & Grow YouTube**

* Own Pickleball TV's YouTube strategy across long-form and Shorts, growing subscribers, views, and watch time.
* Concept and produce long-form YouTube content, such as event recaps, player profiles, instructional series, and behind-the-scenes features.
* Repurpose Pickleball TV programming and match footage into long-form videos built for YouTube audiences.
* Own packaging and optimization: titles, thumbnails, descriptions, chapters, playlists, and upload cadence.
* Use YouTube analytics (retention, click-through rate, traffic sources) to shape what gets made next.

* Run UGC sourcing, including securing rights and credit.
* Build relationships with players, creators, and event partners.
* Stay ahead of trends and platform changes on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts, and move quickly on the right ones.
  

**Lead the Team**

* Manage and develop the production coordinator; brief and review video edits for short- and long-form content.

* Partner with the wider social, video, programming, marketing, and sales teams.
  

**Key Qualifications:**

* 3-5 years in social media, ideally in sports, live events, or entertainment, with a track record of growing channels
* A portfolio of content you've concepted and created for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
* Strong shooting and editing skills (phone-first; CapCut, Premiere, or similar)
* Experience growing a YouTube channel, including long-form content, packaging, and YouTube analytics
* Experience managing or directing others, such as a coordinator, freelancers, or interns
* Fluency with trend cycles and platform best practices

* Comfort under live-event pressure and willingness to travel, including weekends
* Knowledge of pickleball a strong plus

jobs.description:
### **B2B-SMB Outside Sales Representative (1099 + Monthly Stipend)** **Job Summary**

We are looking for an enterprising, self-starting individual to join our team as a **B2B-SMB Outside Sales Representative**. As part of our field sales development team, you will recognize, prospect, and cultivate potential SMB (small and medium-sized business) sales leads, travel to meet directly with business owners and executive decision-makers face-to-face, and endeavor to transform initial sales conversations into lasting, high-value client relationships. Operating within your assigned local territory, you will promote WeLink's next-generation wireless fiber-like internet solutions as a superior, cost-effective alternative to traditional cable and telecom providers. You will leverage your expertise in direct sales, door-to-door prospecting, territory management, and consultative selling to demonstrate how WeLink's telecom technology optimizes business connectivity and improves their bottom line.

### **Outside Sales Representative Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Territory & Field Prospecting:** Travel daily within your designated sales territory to initiate cold visits, build boots-on-the-ground lead pipelines, and meet face-to-face with SMB decision-makers.
* **Consultative Product Presentation:** Maintain comprehensive, expert-level knowledge of WeLink's high-speed internet products, telecom infrastructure, and cloud connectivity services to effectively differentiate our solutions from incumbent providers.
* **Pipeline & CRM Management:** Rigorously manage, track, and update all sales leads, account activities, funnel stages, and closed deals within our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform.
* **Consultative Deal Closing:** Conduct professional needs assessments, overcome client objections, present tailored business proposals, and utilize proven closing strategies to meet or exceed monthly revenue targets.
* **Relationship Building & Post-Sale Support:** Coordinate with sales leadership and operational installation teams to ensure seamless onboarding, maintaining ongoing client touchpoints to realize cross-selling and referral opportunities.

### **Outside Sales Representative Requirements and Qualifications**

* **Sales & Industry Experience:** Proven track record in B2B sales, field sales, outside sales, business development, telecommunications, account management, or technology sales (prior experience selling SMB or MDU telecom solutions is a major plus).
* **Self-Motivated & Entrepreneurial:** A strong self-starting personality with an entrepreneurial spirit, high competitiveness, and the discipline to manage your own territory and schedule without constant supervision.
* **Communication & Negotiation:** Articulate, polished, and persuasive communication skills with a proven ability to establish instant credibility with executives and business owners.
* **Sales Methodology & Tools:** Deep understanding of full-cycle sales techniques, lead generation, sales funnel management, and proficiency with standard CRM software.
* **Mobility Requirements:** Valid driver's license, clean driving record, and reliable personal transportation to navigate your daily field territory. High school diploma or equivalent required.

### **What We Offer**

* **Uncapped 1099 Commission:** Six-figure earning potential directly tied to your performance with an aggressive, uncapped commission structure.
* **90-Day Ramp-Up Support:** A guaranteed **$2,000/month stipend** for your first 90 days of employment to support you as you establish your pipeline and launch your territory.

jobs.title: Associate Sales Representative
jobs.description:
About Mozarc Medical
  
  
At Mozarc Medical, our vision is to reimagine the future of holistic kidney health technology. Established in 2023 out of equal investments from DaVita, a leading provider of kidney care services, and Medtronic, one of the world’s largest medical device companies, Mozarc Medical offers an exciting and unique start-up experience backed by the support of two long-time industry and market leaders.
  
  
Driven by our mission and values, we put our patients at the center of all we do. Our employees play a key role in developing technology solutions that enrich patients’ lives and create meaningful progress in the treatment of kidney disease. Find your purpose and passion at Mozarc Medical.
  
  
Associate Sales Representative
  
  
**Location:** Los Angeles, CA
  
  
**Industry:** Healthcare/Medical Device
  
  
About the Role
  
  
The Associate Sales Representative role is designed for high-potential individuals who are looking to build a successful career in medical device sales. This developmental position provides hands-on field experience, structured training, and mentorship from experienced sales professionals, with the opportunity to progress into a territory-based sales role within approximately 24 months.
  
  
In this role, you will partner with Account Managers and cross-functional teams to drive customer adoption, clinical education, and sales growth across the Renal Care Solutions (RCS) portfolio, including PTA balloons, dialysis catheters, and acute catheters. Through hands-on field experience and training, you will develop the clinical, business, and selling skills needed for a successful career in medical device sales.
  
  
 A Day in the Life | Responsibilities
  
  
As an Associate Sales Representative, you will support sales activities and customer relationships throughout your assigned region by:
  
  
Partnering with Account Managers to develop and execute customer conversion and growth strategies.
  
  
Supporting sales growth by driving product adoption, customer conversions, and new business opportunities.
  
  
Building relationships with physicians, nurses, clinical staff, and key stakeholders through customer education, training, and clinical support activities
  
  
Assisting with territory coverage and account support as business needs require.
  
  
Managing order processing, pricing requests, cross-referencing activities, and other customer-facing administrative responsibilities.
  
  
Collaborating with internal partners and participating in training, sales meetings, and development opportunities to strengthen product and industry knowledge.
  
  
Developing expertise in the RCS product portfolio, sales process, customer needs, and competitive landscape.
  
  
Meeting or exceeding assigned sales and performance objectives.
  
  
Must Have
  
  
Bachelor’s degree required.
  
  
Driver’s License
  
  
 Ability to travel ~50% of time with overnight stays as needed
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
1+ year of sales, healthcare, marketing, or other customer-facing experience
  
  
Training and/or experience in marketing, sales and/or business strategy is a plus
  
  
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills
  
  
Ability to work independently after suitable training and direction given.
  
  
Proven track record of achievement through professional, academic, athletic, military, or leadership experiences.
  
  
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Compensation & Benefits
  
  
**Base Salary:** $60,000
  
  
**Variable Compensation:** In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for our Sales Incentive Plan, offering substantial rewards for strong performance.
  
  
Management by Objectives (MBO)-based bonus structure
  
  
Company vehicle
  
  
Business travel and expenses reimbursed in accordance with company policy
  
  
**Comprehensive benefits package including:** (401)K with company match, generous paid time off, medical, dental & vision coverage, employee assistance resources, ongoing training and professional development opportunities and much more!
  
  
Join Us
  
  
If you're looking to launch a career in medical device sales, this role offers the training, mentorship, and hands-on experience needed to grow into a field sales position while helping improve the lives of patients with kidney disease.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator, California College Corps at CSUDH
jobs.description:
Toro Auxiliary Partners
  
  
Full-Time | Exempt | Benefited | Onsite |
  
  
About CSUDH Toro Auxiliary Partners
  
  
The California State University, Dominguez Hills (CSUDH) Toro Auxiliary Partners was established in 1968 as the university's strategic partner. The Auxiliary provides essential services, supports innovative programs, and enhances initiatives that are integral to the university’s educational mission.
  
  
About CSU Dominguez Hills
  
  
Founded in 1960, CSU Dominguez Hills is one of 23 campuses in the California State University system. The university is recognized for its rich diversity and serves as a vital educational hub for the South Bay region of Los Angeles County. Its mission is to foster academic excellence and community engagement in a dynamic, metropolitan environment.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Operations Coordinator is responsible for the administrative, fiscal, data, and compliance operations of the California College Corps program. This position ensures accurate data management, compliance with state and university requirements, and coordination of student stipend disbursements.
  
  
The Operations Coordinator works closely with the Administrative Director/Program Manager, Program Coordinator, Financial Aid, and campus administrative units (i.e. TAP) to ensure the program operates efficiently and remains audit-ready.
  
  
Essential Responsibilities
  
  

* Data Collection & Management
* Maintains California College Corps participants, service, and partner data systems (i.e., America Learns, e-grants, additional required systems)
* Ensures accurate and timely data entry, verification, and updates.
* Monitors data quality and completeness.
* Generates internal reports as needed.

Position Information
  
  
Employment at Toro Auxiliary Partners is on an at-will basis. It can be terminated by either an employee or Toro Auxiliary Partners at any time with or without cause or advanced notice. Permanent status can neither be obtained nor granted.
  
  
This position is full-time, exempt, benefited, plus employer-sponsored health, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement, and sick/vacation pay.
  
  
**Annual Salary:** $70,304.00
  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  
  
Reporting & Compliance
  
  

* Maintains high quality, regular reporting and communication with the Administrative Director/Program Manager.
* Tracks reporting deadlines and compliance requirements.
* Maintains audit-ready documentation.
* Supports audits and program reviews.
* Per the direction of the Administrative Director/Program Manager may attend CA Volunteer scheduled check-ins.

Fiscal Tracking & Budget Support
  
  

* Tracks program expenditures and stipend allocations.
* Monitors allowable expenses per California College Corps guidelines.
* Works with the Budget Analyst providing required documentation and information for accurate reporting support.
* Timesheets & Service Hours
* Reviews student timesheets for accuracy, compliance and approval.
* Tracks service hours toward program requirements.
* Identifies discrepancies and coordinates resolution with Program Coordinator.
* Ensures timely processing of approved hours.

Financial Aid & Disbursement Coordination
  
  

* Coordinates stipend or scholarship disbursement processes with Financial Aid
* Tracks and confirms disbursement timelines.

Agreements & Compliance Documentation
  
  

* Maintains official records of MOUs, site agreements, and compliance documents.
* Ensures documentation meets institutional and state requirements.

Operational Systems & Processes
  
  

* Under the leadership and guidance of the Administrative Director/Program Manager supports development of and updates standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Supports continuous process improvement.

Required Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Experience in program operations, data management, or compliance.
* Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
* Ability to manage confidential and sensitive information.
* Experience working across campus administrative units.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with California College Corps, AmeriCorps, or other public service programs.
* Familiarity with financial aid or student disbursement processes.
* Experience with compliance reporting and audits.

Operations Coordinator – Performance Metrics
  
  
Data Accuracy & Integrity
  
  

* 99%+ accuracy in participant and service data
* Timely updates to program databases

Reporting & Compliance
  
  

* 100% of required reports submitted on time
* Zero major audit or monitoring findings
* Complete and audit-ready documentation maintained

Fiscal & Disbursement Operations
  
  

* 100% of eligible students receive timely stipends
* No disbursement delays caused by internal processing errors

Timesheet Processing
  
  

* 95%+ of timesheets reviewed and processed within established timelines
* All discrepancies resolved prior to disbursement

Operational Efficiency
  
  

* SOPs followed, maintained and updated per Administrative Director
* Demonstrated improvements in operational workflow

Application Period
  
Applications will be reviewed beginning October 16, 2026, and continue until the position is filled.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
Toro Auxiliary Partners is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against individuals based on race, religion, color, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, medical condition, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws.
  
  
Individuals with disabilities requesting accommodations under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) should contact the TAP Human Resources Office at (310) 243-1070.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the role**

We're searching for a Logistics & Purchasing Coordinator to keep our freight, purchasing, and service operations running smoothly. You'll book LTL freight, manage domestic and international purchase orders and vendor follow-ups, track inventory, field service and warranty issues, and keep our warehouse team and Director of Operations up to date. This is primarily about [80]% computer and phone work, and [20]% on the warehouse floor checking receiving, staging, and inventory. It's a great fit if you've worked as a logistics coordinator, purchasing assistant, or operations admin and like owning the details.

**What you'll do**

**Freight & logistics**

* Book LTL freight shipments, pickups, and deliveries with carriers
* Track shipments and handle delays, missed pickups, damages, and delivery exceptions
* Keep records of bookings, tracking numbers, and carrier details

**Purchasing & vendors**

* Create and manage purchase orders, confirmations, and ETAs
* Follow up with vendors on availability, lead times, pricing, and backorders
* Catch discrepancies between POs, invoices, and received inventory

**Service issues**

* Track customer issues involving damages, missing parts, warranty claims, and replacements
* Coordinate with vendors, technicians, and customer support until each case is resolved
* Escalate high-risk issues before they become chargebacks or cancellations

**Warehouse & inventory**

* Coordinate daily with warehouse staff on receiving, shipping, staging, and order readiness
* Track which units are available, allocated, damaged, returned, or pending shipment
* Support inventory counts and report discrepancies

**Reporting**

* Keep order, shipment, purchasing, and service trackers current by end of day
* Send daily or weekly updates to the Director of Operations, whom you'll report to

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience in freight/logistics coordination, purchasing administration, or operations support
* Hands-on experience booking shipments or managing domestic and international purchase orders
* Comfortable in spreadsheets and at least one ERP, inventory, or order management system
* Able to work on-site full time in Hawthorne
* LTL freight experience

**Nice to have**

* Experience with large-item products such as fitness equipment, furniture, or appliances
* Experience handling warranty or damage claims
* Familiarity with Shopify, Xero, or Salesforce

**About us**

**Total Body Experts LLC** is a leading provider of high-quality fitness equipment and servicing designed for residential & commercial use. At Total Body Experts, we're not just about the equipment; we're on a mission to revolutionize the way the world experiences health and fitness. With a holistic commitment to exercise and customer satisfaction, we serve a diverse range of clients in both B2B & DTC sectors. This is a great opportunity for someone who is organized, hands-on, and passionate about efficiency and problem-solving in a warehouse setting.

Pay: $24.00 - $28.00 per hour

Expected hours: No more than 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Textile Designer & Custom Rug Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Mehraban**

Mehraban is a third-generation Los Angeles rug company specializing in luxury handmade rugs for leading interior designers, architects, hospitality projects, and private residences.

Since 1945, we have combined generations of rug knowledge and craftsmanship with a contemporary approach to design. Our collections include one-of-a-kind, contemporary, antique, and fully custom rugs produced by skilled weaving partners around the world.

We are looking for a talented, highly organized **Textile Designer & Custom Rug Production Coordinator** to join our Los Angeles team.

**The Role**

This is a hybrid **creative, technical, and production-focused position**.

The ideal candidate has a strong eye for design, color, pattern, fashion, and interiors, while also being extremely detail-oriented and comfortable managing the technical and organizational side of custom rug production.

You will work closely with our sales and design teams, clients, interior designers, and international weaving mills to develop custom rugs from initial concept through production.

You will also contribute to Mehraban's creative development by researching emerging trends, colors, materials, fashion, art, and interiors and helping develop new rug concepts and collections.

**Custom Rug Design & Artwork**

* Create professional tear sheets and presentations for custom rug projects.
* Resize, rescale, repeat, crop, and adapt existing artwork to different rug dimensions and shapes.
* Engineer pattern repeats while maintaining the integrity and proportion of the original design.
* Develop custom colorways and recolor existing designs.
* Create rug renderings using Galaincha or similar textile/rug visualization software.
* Prepare Illustrator templates showing artwork, dimensions, colors, materials, and client/project information.
* Occasionally develop original rug designs and concepts for custom projects and Mehraban collections.
* Assist our sales team, clients, and interior designers with custom rug development.

**Creative Research & Product Development**

An important part of this position is bringing a strong creative point of view to the company.

* Research trends across **fashion, interiors, art, architecture, textiles, color, and materials**.
* Identify emerging colors, patterns, textures, and design directions relevant to the luxury interiors market.
* Develop mood boards, color stories, pattern ideas, and new rug concepts.
* Explore archival designs and reinterpret them through new colors, scales, constructions, and materials.
* Collaborate with the Mehraban team on new collections and product development.
* Help maintain a fresh and sophisticated visual direction while respecting Mehraban's design identity.

**Rug Production & Mill Coordination**

* Translate approved artwork into accurate, mill-ready production documents.
* Prepare order documents for custom, stock, and sample rugs.
* Specify dimensions, design scale, colors, fibers, construction, pile height, and other production details.
* Initiate orders with our weaving mills and communicate specifications clearly.
* Maintain regular email correspondence with mills regarding new orders, samples, revisions, production status, and technical questions.
* Follow up on active production and help resolve design or specification issues.
* Maintain accurate internal order records, digital files, and production archives.
* Follow established naming, filing, and ordering procedures.

**Quality Control**

* Review incoming samples, strike-offs, and finished rugs.
* Compare finished pieces against approved artwork, colors, dimensions, and construction specifications.
* Identify discrepancies in color, scale, material, construction, or workmanship.
* Develop an increasingly sophisticated understanding of fibers, weaving techniques, rug construction, pile, texture, and finishing.

**Sample Library & Organization**

Maintaining our physical and digital design resources is an important responsibility of this position.

* Maintain and organize the showroom's rug and textile sample library.
* Properly label, catalog, archive, and track samples and strike-offs.
* Keep samples accessible and organized for the sales and design teams.
* Maintain corresponding digital artwork, specifications, and production records.
* Periodically review and reorganize samples as collections and vendors evolve.

**Additional Creative Support**

As needed, assist with:

* Catalogs and collection presentations.
* Sales presentations and PDF materials.
* Graphic and print materials.
* Website product assets and coordination.
* Coordination of imagery and assets for marketing, social media, SEO/AEO, and other digital initiatives.
* Communication with the warehouse and receiving team regarding incoming rugs and product information.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in **Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop**.
* Strong understanding of vector and raster artwork, pattern repeats, file formats, image resolution, pixel dimensions, and production-ready artwork.
* Excellent eye for **color, scale, proportion, pattern, texture, and composition**.
* Ability to distinguish subtle differences in color, including warm and cool undertones.
* Strong fashion and design sensibility with an awareness of contemporary interiors, art, textiles, and luxury design.
* Extremely detail-oriented and organized.
* Comfortable managing multiple projects and production deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written communication skills and professional email correspondence.
* Ability to maintain organized physical and digital filing systems.
* Willingness and enthusiasm to learn about handmade rugs, fibers, weaving techniques, and construction.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in one or more of the following is highly desirable:

* Textile design
* Surface or pattern design
* Rug or carpet design
* Fashion textiles
* Interior design
* Luxury home furnishings

**POSITION SUMMARY**  
Under the direction of the CEO, the Executive Assistant to the CEO supports the Agencies policies and procedures. The position performs high-level, complex, professional, and specialized administrative support, relieving the CEO of a variety of clerical, technical and administrative duties, including serving as a liaison between the CEO, administration, staff, and the Board. The Executive Assistant has excellent communication skills and will resolve problems and/or recommend solutions and make independent decisions with minimum supervision to support the CEO. It exercises independent judgment while initiating and coordinating office procedures and timelines to provide support for the CEO’s Office and the Agency’s interests.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Coordinates Board meeting documents and assists in the preparation of board meeting room, agenda, webpage updates, attends meetings and prepares meeting minutes.

* Updates, formats, distributes, and maintains the Board’s online policies and the CEO’s administrative procedures and assures all Board related documents are ADA accessible on the Agency website.
* Sets up and maintains a complex management calendar for the CEO, including the maintenance of appointments schedules, scheduling of Board workshops sessions and regular meetings, and arranging for special meetings, conferences, and workshops.

* Maintain confidentiality of records and information, including information regarding Board, Agency, personnel, student, or controversial matters.
* Strong execution in organizational skills and demonstrated experience in prioritizing and executing multiple priorities seamlessly with excellent attention to detail.
* Demonstrated technical proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, with an ability to become familiar with company-specific programs and software.
* Proven excellent project management and organizational skills with demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality, accurate work on time.
* Experience writing and implementing effective office management procedures.
* Review and proof files, forms, records, documents and contracts for accuracy, completeness and conformance to applicable policies, procedures, rules, and regulations.
* Assists the CEO with general administrative operations and compliance, including interpreting rules and regulations and ensuring that administrators complete required reports for submission to various agencies.

* Responds to and assists the CEO in tracking and resolving difficult and sensitive inquires, complaints, and requests for information and assistance.

KaufmanIT is seeking an experienced IT professional to join our team as a Technical Account Manager / vCIO.

**This is a full-time, in-person position in our Irvine office and is not a remote position.**

This role is ideal for someone with a strong technical foundation, approximately an L2 support level or above, who also excels at working with people.

You do **not** need to currently hold a vCIO title.

We are especially interested in candidates who have worked in an MSP environment and understand the unique demands of supporting multiple clients, environments, priorities, and technology stacks at the same time.

The right person will be able to understand a client's technical environment, build strong relationships, communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, identify technology needs and risks, and help translate those needs into actionable technology plans.

This position provides an opportunity for an experienced technical professional to move into a more strategic and client-facing role while remaining connected to technology and our clients' environments.

* Learn and understand each client's business operations, technical environment, goals, risks, and priorities.
* Conduct regular client meetings and Technology Business Reviews (TBRs).
* Review client environments and identify technology needs, security concerns, lifecycle issues, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

* Coordinate with service delivery and project teams to ensure client needs are addressed and expectations are met.
* Identify opportunities to improve client satisfaction and strengthen long-term client relationships.

Everflow is a SaaS Partner Marketing platform for managing and scaling revenue from affiliates, partnerships, and marketing channels.

Founded in 2016 by industry veterans, we have a team distributed across the NAM and EMEA regions.

We’re a bootstrapped and profitable company (over $29M ARR) that has grown through supporting happy customers that refer business to us and create word-of-mouth excitement. We’re the go-to platform for brands, agencies, and networks, with 1,100+ customers including top brands, agencies and networks*.*

#### **About the role**

Our Customer Success Manager, OM will possess the ability to meet or exceed all launch KPI’s; including but not limited to continuously minimizing time to first value, prescriptive guidance on the Everflow tools that support and grow our users’ businesses, and guide a smooth technical launch in collaboration with our Technical Solutions team.

The more you develop your craft, the more your performance — and your paycheck — reflect it.

* **Be Part of a Winning Team:** Join a company recognized as the best in the industry and contribute to our continued success and growth.

jobs.title: Assistant Community Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**

The Assistant Community (Property) Manager assists the Community Manager in the successful site management of the apartment community providing the necessary leadership, guidance and motivation to ensure a positive working environment and quality community living. The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for administering the day-to-day leasing office operations and is responsible for overseeing all computer input of the apartment community. The Assistant Community Manager directs the leasing staff, and works with the Community Manager to recommend marketing and leasing strategies designed to meet the goals of Shea Properties. The pay range for this position is $27.00 - $29.00/hour and the Assistant Community Manager is also eligible to participate in the office Sales Bonus, Club Shea Program and the discretionary annual bonus plan. JF Shea offers a competitive benefits package including PTO, paid holidays, medical, dental, vision, 401K, disability, life insurance, 35% discounted apartment (based on availability), and cell phone allowance.

**Job Duties**

* Leads and participates in lineup each morning.
* Ensures craigslist ads are posted daily.
* In conjunction with the Community Manager, supervises the input of all data into designated property management software and processing of related reports.
* Reviews and approves move out statements (SODA), ensuring all statements are completed timely in accordance with state law and that all charges are necessary and accurate as outlined in Shea Properties policies.
* Reviews and approves resident rental applications for move-ins in a fair and consistent manner in accordance with Fair Housing requirements and Shea Business Properties' policies and procedures.
* Assists in negotiation of rent increases and lease renewals with residents and supports the Community Manager in the execution of all necessary documents to implement all approved rental increases.
* In conjunction with the Community Manager, coordinates with Leasing and Maintenance staff a calendar of scheduled move-ins, ensuring all move-in appointments are completed and all apartments are inspected prior to move-in.
* In conjunction with Community Manager reviews Yieldstar each morning and submits pricing recommendations.
* Maintains all residents and vendor files, ensuring completeness and accuracy of all paperwork and documentation.
* Under the direction of the Community Manager, ensures the preparation and delivery of all legal and formal notices, including Three Day or 30 Covenant to Quit, Rent Increase Notices, Late Charge Notices, and Notices of Violation of Community Rules and Regulations, in accordance to California Civil Code and Shea Properties policy and procedure.
* Ensures the maintenance of all account records and transactions including NSF's, Rent Allowances, Concessions, Rent Increases, Utility Billing Collection, and other management approved debits/credits.
* Prepares beginning of the week (Monday Morning) reports in an accurate and timely manner.
* In conjunction with the Community Manager, directs the functions of the leasing office, supervise the leasing staff’s daily activities and the preparation of all leasing paperwork and documents related to residency. Ensures schedule of leasing staff to ensure proper staff levels in anticipation of traffic demands and workload.
* Acts as gate keeper for Avid Exchange
* Prepares work orders and submits for approval in Go Cart.
* Assists in the development, preparation and administration of the capital and operating budgets for the property.
* Participates in staff selection process. Recruits, hires, and trains all leasing staff under the approval and direction of the Community Manager.
* Prepares annual reviews for all direct reports, sets Incentive-Based Compensation Bonus Plan (IBC) goals and objectives and implements Professional Development Plans (PDP) for all associates.
* Supports and motivates staff to participate in company sponsored classes and provided training, with the objective of completing PDP and individual goals. Ensures compliance with all mandatory training.
* Oversee and/or conduct weekly sales “leasing fundamentals” meetings, sign and submit fundamentals to Regional Manager for review.
* Supports industry networking and encourages direct reports to participate in industry association functions.
* Performs other duties as assigned. Actual job duties and responsibilities may vary depending on the size of the community.
* Handle on-call duties, as directed by supervisor.

**Technical/Professional Knowledge (*****Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience*****)**

* Effective oral and written communication skills; ability to give clear direction and respond to inquiries.Must be able to speak effectively before groups of customers or associates of the organization.
* Understanding of accounting principles and budget process. Ability to read and interpret numerical information. Basic understanding of the budgeting process.
* Basic understanding of marketing concepts; analyzing data; and report writing.
* Customer service experience required in at least one of the following industries: property management, hospitality, retail, and real estate.
* Negotiate and resolve conflicts.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (Word/Excel/Outlook) and Yardi & Yieldstar preferred.
* Prior experience in managing a staff (supervise, train, coach, develop, motivate, interview, hire, terminate) and lead by example.
* High School Diploma or equivalent. Some college level courses preferred.
* Minimum of 2 years property management experience with at least 1 year at the management level.

The Assistant Community Manager works on-site at an apartment community and interfaces with external/internal customers, residents, and vendors on a regular basis. The position work schedule varies depending on the property. Hours are usually scheduled from 9 a.m. – 6 p.m. However, office sta

**Who We Are:**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

 **Requirements**

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: being onsite to set-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem-solve, and ensure high quality set-up and customer experience
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point-of-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
