jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - GI Division
jobs.description:
The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will join the GI Division and responsibilities will include coordination of clinical research studies related liver disease and liver transplantation. The Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies. The CRC will work on the DeLIVER Care, provides HCV screening and low-threshold standard of care HCV treatment on at various locations in San Francisco on a mobile van.

CRC’s duties may include, management and coordinating the tasks of multiple clinical research studies, act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; coordinate staff work schedules, assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist PI supervisor with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.

The CRC will also be responsible for performing fingersticks for rapid HCV antibody testing and/or HCV RNA, venipuncture for HCV RNA confirmatory testing and other labs, driving the van, and completing research activities such as consenting participants, extracting information from medical records, completing case report forms, data collection, and data entry. The CRC is required to be experienced in research with “hard-to-reach” and vulnerable populations, knowledge of resources for HCV and HIV prevention and education, drug abuse prevention and treatment, and street and community-based outreach methods. Phlebotomy certification is preferred, but not required. Having experience performing phlebotomy with people experiencing homelessness and people who inject drugs is preferable.

  

Required Qualifications:

* California Driver's License
* High Schol Diplima; or equivalent experience/training
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments and outside institutions; and the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines

Preferred Qualifications:

* BA or BS in physical or biological sciences and one year of clinical research experience
* Fluency in the usage of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of UCSF and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.); knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing/shipping infectious substances, database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms
* Experience applying the following regulations and guidelines:

  + Good Clinical Practice Guidelines
  + Health Information and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
  + The Protection of Human Research Subjects
  + CHR regulations for recruitment and consent of research subjects
  + Effective Cash Handling Procedures
  + Environmental Health and Safety Training
  + Fire Safety Training
  + Experience working with programs serving people experiencing homelessness and/or substance dependence

License/Certifications:

* California Driver's License

  + Does the job demonstrably require driving as a core function? Yes
  + Can the essential tasks of the role be performed adequately without driving? No- the CRC will be responsible for driving the van to and from outreach shifts and vehicle maintenance services
  + If driving is required, would using alternative transportation (like public transit, carpooling) significantly impact the employee's ability to perform job duties in terms of time and cost to the employer? Yes
  + If required to drive, will use of a university vehicle be required? Yes
  + Will use of a personal vehicle be required? No
  + Will the position be required to drive frequently (more than 10 hours month)? Yes
  + Will position be required to drive outside of city or county limits? Yes
  + Will position need to register with the California Pull Program? Yes

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Sobhani Research Group (PI: Nasim Sobhani) is dedicated to improving the care of pregnant individual and their infants. The bulk of our studies are focused on diabetes in pregnancy and how to optimize the care of pregnant people living with diabetes. Our studies examine how to improve perinatal outcomes for pregnant individuals with type 1 and type 2 diabetes; leverage advanced diabetes technology in the pregnant population; diagnose and manage gestational diabetes; and better support the emotional and behavioral needs of pregnant individuals with diabetes.

The Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.

Incumbent’s duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports, including ensuring complete and accurate data capture; attend regular meetings with the PI and/or other members of the study team; coordinate staff work schedules, assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; support the development and submission of publications, presentations, reports, and other study-related documents; and perform other duties as assigned.

The CRC will assist the Sobhani Research Group with multiple projects. The CRC will design and develop RedCap databases, enroll patients in research studies and complete chart reviews, data collection and data for later data analysis. The CRC will also perform and/or coordinate biospecimen collection with study participants, coordinate with research team staff, perform initial sample processing and stabilization, and ensure transfer of the specimens to partnering research labs as needed. The CRC will work on IRB/CHR applications and submit protocols, regulatory documents, modifications and updates to the CHR for various ongoing studies. The CRC will coordinate with our multidisciplinary team and collaborators across departments within UCSF as well as non-UCSF campuses. This includes outreach and communication with referring healthcare providers and patient support organizations.

A successful candidate will have a desire to work directly with patients; be passionate about supporting research studies that aim to improve our understanding of pregnancy complications; be dedicated to optimizing the care of individuals with medically complex pregnancies; be committed to the development of evidence-based practices. They will be an independent problem-solver with excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills. They will have a high level of professionalism, an exceptional attention to detail, and experience managing multiple projects and timelines simultaneously. This is a great opportunity for an individual who is interested in academic research, medicine, health care, or public health. A two-year commitment is preferred.

**DEPARTMENT INFO:**

The Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology and Reproductive Sciences (Ob, Gyn & RS) is a major academic Department in the School of Medicine, engaged in clinical, research and training activities at the Parnassus, Mount Zion, and Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital campuses, the new Betty Irene Moore Women’s Hospital at Mission Bay, as well as satellite locations throughout the Bay Area, with an annual operating budget of $150 million. The Department has 134 full-time faculty, 117 other academic appointees, 13 post-doctoral fellows, 22 clinical fellows, 32 residents, 138 voluntary clinical faculty and 270 staff.

The mission of the Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences is to improve the lives and health of all women through excellence, innovation and leadership in patient care, scientific discovery, education, advocacy, and diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing quality health care services; educating health care providers and investigators; and conducting research to advance knowledge in our field.

* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal

jobs.title: Account Manager/Technical Manager (7972)
jobs.description:
**Account Manager/Technical Manager (7972)**
============================================

**TSMC North America**

**Account Manager / Technical Manager**

**Overview of Role**

TSMC North America is seeking an Account Manager / Technical Manager, based in San Jose, CA, to own the technical account relationship for one of TSMC’s key global customers serving diverse sectors, including data center, networking, broadband, and industrial markets. You will serve as a primary interface between the customer’s technical and procurement organizations, driving and managing both front-end silicon technology and backend packaging programs (2.5D/3D advanced packaging). The role demands fluency in semiconductor design, processes, and advanced packaging, strong commercial acumen, and the emotional intelligence to build synergy within an established, high-workload account team while operating independently and keeping tight alignment with TSMC headquarters. You will report to the Account Management team leader and partner with senior customer and TSMC stakeholders to strengthen the partnership and deliver measurable value across cost, quality, and time-to-market. TSMC currently operates a hybrid work schedule (4 days in office).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the account relationship for the assigned strategic customer, serving as the primary TSMC technical and commercial interface and sustaining executive-level alignment.
* Manage the customer’s selected front-end silicon and advanced packaging programs — 2.5D/3D packaging — from planning through production ramp. Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding customer’s product roadmaps and positioning the appropriate TSMC technologies.
* Translate customer product requirements into actionable programs with R&D, Planning, Field Technical Support (FTS), Business Development, Operations, and Finance, and coordinate closely with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan.
* Anticipate and address customer challenges, balancing TSMC’s objectives with the customer’s product and operational priorities.
* Manage capacity and fulfillment cycles with procurement, design, and business units, ensuring consistent demand creation and supply alignment.
* Provide structured business analysis and briefings for Account Directors, VPs, and senior TSMC executives.

***Minimum Qualifications***

* BS/MS in Engineering, Physical Science, Business, or a related technical discipline.
* 12+ years of combined experience in account management, applications/field engineering, technical program management, or foundry/OSAT/OEM supply chain within the semiconductor industry.
* Strong knowledge of semiconductor processes, fab operations, and supply chain dynamics.
* Strong project management with the ability to synthesize complex technical and business insights into clear executive recommendations.
* High emotional intelligence and proven ability to build strong working relationships and integrate into an established, capacity-constrained, customer-facing team.
* Excellent executive communication, negotiation, and conflict‑management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ability to analyze and interpret financial statements.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Prior TSMC or foundry account management / customer service experience supporting North America accounts.
* Experience in semiconductor design, device, process, product engineering, or advanced packaging.
* Experience coordinating across highly matrixed, multi-geography teams and with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan.
* Bilingual in Mandarin and English.

***Travel Expectations***

* Monthly travel (~10%) to customer sites within the USA.
* Annual travel to TSMC headquarters in Taiwan.

**Company Description**

As a trusted technology and capacity provider, TSMC is driven by the desire to be:

* **The world’s leading dedicated semiconductor foundry**
* **The technology leader with a strong reputation for manufacturing excellence**
* **Advancing semiconductor manufacturing innovations to enable the future of technology**

TSMC pioneered the pure-play foundry business model when it was founded in 1987 and has been the world’s leading dedicated semiconductor foundry ever since. The Company supports a thriving ecosystem of global customers and partners with the industry’s leading process technologies and a portfolio of design enablement solutions to unleash innovation for the global semiconductor industry. With global operations spanning Asia, Europe, and North America, TSMC serves as a committed corporate citizen around the world.

In North America, TSMC has a strong sales and service organization that works with customers by helping them achieve silicon success with cutting-edge technologies and manufacturing excellence. The Company has continued to accelerate its R&D investment and staffing in recent years and is expanding its manufacturing footprint to support customer innovation with 3D IC technologies and optimal manufacturing capacity.

**Export Control**

For positions requiring access to technical data subject to export control regulations, including Export Administration Regulations, TSMC North America may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Government for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon TSMC North America obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by the U.S. Government.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Packaging Industry
jobs.description:
**Who is Golden West Packaging Group (GWPG)?**

We are a leading West Coast mill-independent specialty packaging and printing business. We are the people behind the innovative packaging solutions that make it possible for our customers’ products to reach our community – at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between.

With 13 manufacturing facilities primarily in California and Washington state, our extensive production capabilities include structural and graphic design, value-added converting, flexographic printing, and lithographic lamination. Our advanced, environmentally sustainable packaging solutions serve a wide range of well-known customer brands across multiple industries including agriculture, food services, medical device, food products, wineries, high tech, pharma, cosmetics and many more!

**Why is Golden West Packaging Group THE place to work?**

We are a well-established, growing company in a stable industry that is re-imagining itself to be a place where everyone knows everyone, where you can make a difference, and where you can learn and grow professionally.

We are focused on safety and building an employee-centric work environment where team members can experience camaraderie, relevance, and career advancement.

As the packaging and logistics sector continues to grow, we’re growing with it and creating new opportunities. Come make your mark at a company that strives to celebrate your individuality, skills, and talents.

At Golden West Packaging Group, you’ll feel the difference and make a difference

**The Role You’ll Play**

The primary responsibility of the person in this position is to strategically grow sales and increase the Golden West (GW)’s profitability by developing, leading, and driving the GWPG sales strategy to identify and gain sales contracts that benefit the customer and advance Golden West profitable business growth strategies.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify and target new business opportunities through strategic prospecting, market research and networking
* Conduct sales presentations, pitches, and product demonstrations to showcase our packaging solutions
* Collaborate with other team members on the development of customized packaging products and service solutions to increase customer satisfaction and optimize GW’s sales profitability within a given product or market category.
* Generate new business opportunities in assigned categories to grow sales and increase Golden West’s market share
* Forecast sales projections, track performance metrics, and provide regular reports to management
* Stay current to market and customer trends and developments for given categories to identify new sales opportunities to expand existing customer sales volumes and new sales opportunities
* Ensure sales meet contributions margin requirements and ensure GW’s business sustainability
* Develop strategies to expand GW’s business and profitability
* Research competition and business climate for category to identify and mitigate risk of potential business threats and to optimize potential business opportunities
* Serve as the primary point of contact for existing customers, building strong relationships and understanding their needs
* Define business plans and strategies for assigned category to gain market share and maximize profitability and execute against such strategies to achieve plans

**What You’ll Get**

* A friendly, team-based, supportive work environment
* Competitive total compensation package
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, vision, dental, life insurance, and 401K plan with employer contribution
* Employee Assistance coverage with full services, including dietary and nutritional services, retirement planning and support services
* 10 paid holidays per year
* Paid time off
* Progressive employee referral program
* Professional development and career growth opportunities

If this sounds like you and if you have what it takes to push boundaries and seize opportunities, we invite you to apply today!

**What You’ll Need**

**Required skills, knowledge and abilities:**

* Effective sales skills using a data-based, solution sales approach
* Proven track record of successful selling
* Strong organizational skills, discipline and attention to detail
* Customer focused mentality and approach to business
* Expert knowledge and understanding of industry packaging needs and solutions
* Strong verbal and written communications skills
* Proven analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong collaboration, interpersonal and relationship building skills

**Required education and experience:**

* B.S/A. in business administration or related field
* 5+ years of experience in sales and solutions sales with a proven track record of success
* Experience in packaging industry is desired

Golden West Packaging Group is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind.

California Pay Transparency Disclaimer: This is an Exempt position. The pay range for this position is $90,000.00 to $135,000.00. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role. Actual placement within range will be contingent upon several factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s qualifications, education, experience, internal equity and alignment with market data.

jobs.title: Strategic Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Diodes Incorporated is seeking a Strategic Account Sales Manager responsible for new business development, revenue growth, and strategic account management within a select group of major accounts. The successful candidate will support customers in identifying products, solutions, and services that best meet their needs while driving demand creation, design wins, and long-term growth opportunities. This position serves as the primary interface between the customer and Diodes' Business Units (BUs), Field Applications Engineers (FAEs), Marketing, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and Executive Leadership teams.

**Principle Duties and Responsibility:**

* Build and manage Account Plans for each assigned account and territory, keeping the extended team of stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned to achieve growth objectives.
* Develop, communicate, and execute customer-specific account strategies based on compelling value propositions that drive new business opportunities and revenue growth.
* Own the design, deployment, and execution of winning account strategies to identify and capture every viable project, design opportunity, and revenue stream within assigned accounts.
* Drive demand creation activities by identifying customer roadmaps, projects, applications, and emerging technologies, aligning Diodes' product portfolio with customer requirements.
* Lead design-in and design-win activities across all Business Units to secure production business and increase market share.
* Develop and maintain an extensive knowledge base of assigned accounts, including business structure, technology roadmaps, key stakeholders, competitive landscape, purchasing processes, organizational dynamics, and strategic priorities.
* Collaborate closely with Business Unit Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, and FAEs to position products, develop technical solutions, and successfully close new design opportunities.
* Coordinate customer visits, technical reviews, executive meetings, and strategic planning sessions to strengthen customer relationships and uncover growth opportunities.
* Act as the primary escalation point for competitive, technical, quality, qualification, delivery, and commercial issues.
* Maintain accurate sales funnels, forecasts, opportunity pipelines, and account plans, providing visibility to Business Units and management on future revenue opportunities.
* Track and drive design wins from concept through production, ensuring alignment between customer requirements and internal execution.
* Communicate customer roadmaps, market trends, competitive intelligence, and emerging opportunities to Business Units to influence product development priorities and go-to-market strategies.
* Coordinate globally across sales organizations, Business Units, engineering teams, supply chain, and operations to facilitate alignment and strategic account execution.
* Conduct face-to-face customer management meetings as necessary to provide support, address issues, communicate updates, and build executive-level relationships.
* Negotiate and facilitate business matters including pricing, contracts, supply commitments, delivery schedules, and commercial agreements.
* Lead cross-functional teams consisting of Sales, FAEs, Product Marketing, Business Units, Quality, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and Global Operations to achieve account objectives and revenue targets.
* Operate effectively within a highly matrixed global organization while driving accountability and execution across multiple functional groups.
* Respect and comply with all Diodes personnel, sales, proposal, and contract policies, while operating within company travel and expense guidelines.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* 5+ years of sales experience in the semiconductor industry with strategic account management, key account management, and/or territory management responsibilities.
* Proven success managing large strategic customers and complex sales opportunities within OEM, Cloud, AI, Industrial, Consumer, Communications, Networking, Computing, or Automotive markets.
* Preferred BSEE or BS degree with relevant semiconductor, electronics, or technology industry experience.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand customer architectures, product requirements, design challenges, and competitive solutions.
* Demonstrated experience driving demand creation, design-in, and design-win activities resulting in measurable revenue growth.
* Thorough understanding of semiconductor market dynamics, customer buying behaviors, competitive positioning, and industry trends.
* Proven ability to influence and coordinate global cross-functional resources to remove barriers and achieve customer and revenue objectives.
* Strong forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, and opportunity management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-building, negotiating, and closing skills with customers at engineering, procurement, management, and executive levels.
* Proven ability to build trust-based relationships and influence decision-makers throughout customer organizations.

Do you enjoy customer service and building meaningful connections? Are you self-driven and find excitement in sales activities?

As a **Service Account Manager**, you will have the opportunity to actively seek out, manage, and nurture a portfolio of key accounts within the mechanical contracting industry. Your primary responsibility is to provide exceptional customer service while fostering strong relationships with both new and existing clients. The Service Account Manager will use their expertise and industry knowledge to navigate customers through the sales process and ensure satisfaction with our products and services.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Develop and manage a portfolio of key accounts in the mechanical industry specializing in service agreements, repairs and projects.
* Drive client engagement and satisfaction by evaluating operations through on-site inspections and offer expert HVAC, plumbing and piping solutions that are tailored to client’s needs.
* Proactively generate new business through prospecting, cold calling, emails, and onsite meetings with prospective clients.
* Identify growth potential with existing accounts, analyzing performance, and developing strategies to enhance client satisfaction, retention, and revenue.
* Build and manage a robust sales pipeline, tracking customer interactions, forecasts, and presenting updates during monthly meetings.
* Create detailed proposals for new and existing clients, outlining scopes of work tailored to their unique requirements.
* Follow up with submitted customer proposals on a weekly basis, maintaining communication to address inquiries or modifications.
* Tracks annual contract renewals, engaging with clients prior to expiration for repeat business.
* Identify and pursue cross-selling opportunities for Plumbing services by collaborating with internal partners to deliver comprehensive service offerings.
* Maintain a competitive edge by staying abreast of market trends, emerging technologies, and industry advancements within the assigned region.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery and act as a liaison between clients and various departments within SVM.

**EDUCATION, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* 2+ years’ experience as a HVAC Account Manager or Sales Representative **required**.
* 2+ years’ experience working with a Mechanical Contractor or related field **required**.
* High school diploma or general education degree (GED; or equivalent combination of education and experience) **required.**
* Proficient knowledge of HVAC systems and terminology utilized in the Mechanical Industry **required.**
* Proven experience successfully establishing and managing a book of business **required.**
* Demonstrates strong technical aptitude with experience writing grammatically correct customer proposals **required.**
* Proven ability to overcome objections and challenges with customers **required.**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to maintain strong relationships **required.**
* Highly proficient with various office equipment and programs including MS Office Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel), Accounting Software or a CRM **required.**
* Possesses a valid California’s Driver’s License and willing to submit to a DMV report **a must.**

**COMPENSATION & COMPANY BENEFITS INCLUDE**

This is a full-time exempt position. The compensation for this role is $100,000- $170,000 annually and is based on experience and skillset.

**Health:** Medical / Dental / Vision / Life & Disability Insurance / FSA

**Well-Being**: Robust Maternity & Paternity Leave / EAP / Paid Holidays / PTO / Sick Leave / Interactive Breakroom

**Financial Wellness**: Deferred Compensation Plan / 401k w/ Employer Contribution / Employee Referral Bonus / “Positive Pulse”

**Community Investment**: Volunteer Opportunities / Team Building Activities / Employee Activities

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

As a Service Account Manager the Mechanical Contracting Industry, there are certain physical requirements you should be aware of. These requirements ensure that you are capable of performing the necessary tasks safely and effectively. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to qualified applicants who may not be able to fulfil certain aspects of the role. The key physical requirements for this role are outlined below:

* This role may involve physical activity including walking, standing, climbing, and driving to customer sites.
* This role may requirecarrying equipment, samples, or marketing materials when visiting customers which could result in carrying up to 50lbs.
* This role may require working at elevated heights and changing work conditions while surveying customer equipment including construction sites and commercial buildings.
* This role may require navigating through tight spaces, such as crawlspaces, attics, or mechanical rooms to review customer equipment.
* This role may require reviewing and interpreting technical specifications, equipment manuals and other relevant documents.
* This role may require the use of ladders and personal protective equipment (PPE) during customer site visits.

**WHO WE ARE**

At SVM, we are more than just a leading mechanical contractor specializing in design-build commercial HVAC, plumbing, piping, service/maintenance, and 24-hour emergency services. We’re a team dedicated to supporting the Bay Area, Sacramento, and Nevada regions with trusted expertise and an unwavering commitment to delivering exceptional experiences at every level.

Our success is built on a collaborative culture that values teamwork, innovation, and doing the right thing. We take pride in fostering an inclusive and welcoming environment where every team member feels supported, valued, and empowered to grow. At SVM, we believe our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize their development, well-being, and success.

**Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. You'll own customer success end to end: study startup, go-live, and study ops. Day-to-day, that means working directly with researchers and sponsors to get their studies launched and run well.

The work comes down to four things: relationship management, tool building, excellent follow-through, and both an instinct and an analytic approach for what makes a great study.

* Run study kickoff and onboarding: offer input on protocol digitization and study decentralization

* Own the client communication cadence: status updates, mid-study check-ins, results walkthroughs. Build the systems that generate these updates

**Who you are**

* You're product-minded: you've built workflows, automations, or internal tools, and you reach for AI tooling by default

* You prepare for every meeting: clients notice, and so do we
* You're organized under pressure: multiple concurrent studies won't rattle you
* You're creative: when the obvious process doesn't fit, you invent one that does

**Nice to have**

* Clinical credentials or a health sciences background
* Experience at an early-stage company where you built the function rather than inherited it
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Intercom, or IRB submission tools

**Benefits**

We want our team to feel supported, in work and in life. Alethios offers:

**About HappyRobot**
--------------------

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly motivated **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to join our growing team. As an SDR, you will play a key role in driving our company’s growth by generating and qualifying new business opportunities.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, research, and engage potential clients through outbound prospecting.
* Manage and maintain an organized pipeline of prospects in the CRM.
* Collaborate with sales and marketing to refine messaging and outreach strategies.
* Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities.
* Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly KPIs for outreach, meetings, and opportunities generated.

**Must have**

* 1-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or a related role (preferably in tech).
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Experience with CRM tools.
* Highly motivated, goal-oriented, and a team player.
* Founder Mindset - You're here for a reason and ready to take risks for something unknown.
* Prior experience in SaaS or a tech startup is a plus.

**Why join us?**
----------------

* Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
* Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
* Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
* Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
* Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

**Our Operating Principles**
----------------------------

***Extreme Ownership***

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

***Craftsmanship***

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

***We are “majos”***  
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

***Urgency with Focus***  
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

***Talent Density and Meritocracy***  
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

***First-Principles Thinking***  
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

Title: Social Media Coordinator, Community Management (PF1)

The Role: New York Life is seeking a Social Media Coordinator to join its Experience & Digital Marketing team and help support the day-to-day execution of New York Life's organic social media program. This role will operate as a generalist, supporting social listening, community management, content creation, publishing, reporting, and requests across core corporate brand channels and enterprise partners.

  

We're looking for someone who is a strong writer, highly organized, comfortable capturing short-form video, and able to coordinate across multiple stakeholders. You're detail-oriented, calm under pressure, and skilled at translating conversations and data into insights, with a genuine curiosity about how AI-powered search and discovery are changing how audiences find and engage with brands.

  

Social listening and community management are this role's primary focus, helping turn conversations into insights that inform content and strategy. You'll also assist with social content production as needed.

  

This position reports to the Social Media Lead and works with stakeholders across the enterprise, agency partners, and platform teams. You'll collaborate closely with teams including Corporate Communications, Human Resources, Legal, Strategy, SEO, Paid Media, Service, and Sponsorships, among others.

-

Our Team:

The Social Media team leads New York Life’s enterprise organic social media presence. Build awareness, consideration, and trust in New York Life by strengthening its presence across social media and emerging digital discovery experiences. Deliver relevant, useful content that reflects New York Life’s expertise and creates meaningful connections with audiences.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About City Winery**

Imagine a sold-out show, a glass of wine made on-site, and a great dinner, all under one roof. That's City Winery. Every year we produce thousands of concerts and hundreds of wines across ten live entertainment venues in nine metropolitan areas. Each venue is also a working winery and restaurant. We also run five standalone restaurants and winegardens.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Coordinator to join our digital marketing team and help fill the room, night after night. Reporting to our Digital Marketing Manager, you'll build, launch, and optimize paid social and programmatic campaigns that turn a scroll into a ticket sale, and you'll see the results of your work in real time as shows sell out.

This is an entry-level role built for learning. From day one you'll manage live campaigns on the major ad platforms, work with real budgets, and learn performance marketing fundamentals from an experienced team. Because the team is small, your ideas and your work will be seen and will make a real difference. If you love digital marketing and want to start your career in live music, food, and wine, we'd love to meet you.  
  
 **What You'll Do**

* Build and launch digital ad campaigns for shows at City Winery venues on platforms including Meta, Google, TikTok, StackAdapt, Vibe, and LinkedIn.
* Monitor and optimize ad spend, CPA, and ROAS so every dollar works as hard as possible.
* Write and refresh ad copy that matches the City Winery brand voice, priority keywords, and website messaging.
* Test new ideas across creative, audiences, and targeting, measure what works, and share what you learn with the team.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports and turn the numbers into clear takeaways.
* Work with local marketing teams at each venue so campaigns support their show calendars and overall strategy.
* Help track progress against annual paid media goals.
* Implement AI Search and SEO tactics that improve search performance, including maintaining search listings and updating website content.
* Support other digital marketing priorities such as email, and SMS as needed.
* Keep up with digital advertising trends and bring new ideas to the table.

  
**What You'll Learn**  

* How to plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across multiple paid social and programmatic platforms
* How to read performance data and connect ad spend to ticket sales
* How live events are marketed, from announcement to on-sale to sold out
* How AI tools can speed up campaign creation, testing, and reporting
* How a small, fast-moving digital team works across ecommerce, venues, and brand

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree required; a degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related field is preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the curiosity to ask questions when something isn't clear
* A basic understanding of digital marketing concepts. Coursework, internships, and personal projects all count.
* Comfort with Google Workspace, especially spreadsheets
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines on your own
* A tech-savvy mindset and interest in how AI tools can make marketing smarter and faster
* A genuine passion for music, food, wine, and live entertainment
* Based in New York City, with potential, occasional travel to other City Winery locations

**Bonus Points**

* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, StackAdapt, Vibe, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4) or other analytics tools
* Experience managing local listings

**About Us**

Wine, food, and live entertainment collide at City Winery to create a dynamic and incredibly unique workplace. Since 2008, City Winery has been turning heads across the nation with amazing live performances, delectable cuisine, and award winning, locally produced wines. But there's more to us than that we're a haven for community and creativity, a place where the philosophy of hospitality is more than just a buzzword, but a way of life. City Winery, founded by music industry veteran & visionary Michael Dorf, has established itself as a one-of-a-kind brand providing unforgettable experiences for guests. From world class music venues to sustainably produced wines with ratings of 90+ points, City Winery offers a range of topnotch events & experiences.

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at City Winery. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Additionally, City Winery participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.**

**Job Title**: **Tradeshow & Events Operations Coordinator**

**Location**: Hoboken, NJ

**Division:** Management

**About Us:**

Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an innovative, integrated photonics company that provides accessible and affordable quantum machines to the world today. QCi products are designed to operate at room temperature and low power at an affordable cost. The Company’s portfolio of core technology and products offer unique capabilities in the areas of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, cyber security as well as remote sensing applications.

**Scope of the Job:**

QCi is seeking a highly organized, resourceful, and hands-on **Tradeshow & Events Operations Coordinator** to help plan and execute the company’s tradeshows, conferences, exhibitions, customer events, and industry engagements.

The Coordinator will work closely with the Tradeshow & Events Specialist and partner with Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Engineering, and executive leadership to deliver professional, engaging, and well-organized event experiences.

* Communicate with event organizers, venues, general contractors, freight and drayage providers, AV partners, printers, booth vendors, and promotional-item suppliers.
* Obtain and organize vendor quotes, orders, invoices, deadlines, and deliverables.
* Monitor vendor activities before and during events to ensure requirements are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Escalate potential risks and help resolve logistical or operational issues quickly and professionally.

Through our core ingredient platforms that we’re known for globally – cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts, and spices – we partner with food and beverage manufacturers, retailers, and foodservice operators worldwide to help meet evolving consumer needs.

jobs.description:
**About RugsUSA**

Founded in 1998, Rugs USA has grown into a trusted online destination for high-quality rugs that bring style and value to every space. Today, we have a growing portfolio of home and lifestyle brands, all with a shared commitment to making it easier for people to create spaces they love. Our portfolio includes Annie Selke, known for thoughtfully designed home goods rooted in quality craftsmanship; and nuLOOM, which makes design-forward rugs accessible at a range of price points.

We’re passionate about the difference the right pieces can make in a space, so we’ve built close relationships with designers, artisans, and factories around the world. Those partnerships help us keep our model simple, offer great value, and bring customers a wide range of styles.

Whether someone is refreshing a room or starting from scratch, we want the process to feel easy and inspiring. Our curated assortment gives customers the pieces they need to bring their vision for home to life, whatever their style or price point.

**Position Overview**

The Ecommerce Account Manager is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities, support needs, and growth opportunities for a portfolio of wholesale and marketplace ecommerce accounts. This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned web-based customers, ensuring they have accurate product information, pricing, imagery, specifications, and the tools needed to successfully market and sell our products online.

The Ecommerce Account Manager will work closely with customers, Codarus representatives, and the Annie Selke Inside Sales Representative team to provide timely information, resolve issues, support account growth, and deliver reporting and insights that drive business results.

**Essential Job Functions**

Manage the daily operational needs of multiple wholesale and marketplace ecommerce accounts.

* Serve as the primary contact for customers and reps regarding product information, pricing, promotional calendar, imagery, specifications, inventory inquiries, and account support.
* Respond promptly to customer questions and requests, coordinating with internal teams as needed to provide solutions.
* Monitor account performance and identify opportunities to improve sales, product visibility, and overall business growth.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, reps, and key stakeholders.
* Act as the main point of contact for Codarus representatives and the AS ISR team and/or Marketplace account managers regarding ecommerce account information and support.
* Prepare and distribute reports, sales updates, product information, and other requested business insights.
* Coordinate new product launches, assortment updates, pricing changes, and content updates across assigned accounts.
* Ensure account data and product information remain accurate and up to date across customer platforms.
* Escalate and help resolve customer issues, content discrepancies, and operational challenges.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Operations, and Product teams to support customer needs and business objectives.

**You Have**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in ecommerce, account management, customer support, sales operations, or a related field.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
* Experience working with ecommerce marketplaces, wholesale accounts, product content, and digital assets is preferred.
* Ability to analyze information, identify opportunities, and recommend solutions.
* Self-motivated with a proactive, customer-focused approach.

**Your Life and Career at RugsUSA**

* A culture that promotes a healthy work/life balance
* Benefits package offered to all eligible full-time employees (including medical, dental, vision, PTO, 401(k)
* Exposure to career advancement opportunities across all departments
* Generous employee discount that can be used across our house of brands!

  
**The pay range for this role is:**  
75,000 - 90,000 USD per year(Manhattan Office)

jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Account Manager, AMER
jobs.description:
**ABOUT TALON.ONE:**

  

Talon.One is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, promotions and gamification into one holistic platform. Backed by enterprise-grade security and scalability, Talon.One empowers companies to build personalized, profitable promotions and loyalty programs using any data.

Today, over 250 of the world's most-loved brands including Adidas, Sephora and Carlsberg work with Talon.One to drive deeper engagement and lasting loyalty with their customers.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Join our team as an Enterprise Technical Account Manager at Talon.One, where you'll play a key role in driving the success of our API-first promotion engine for our enterprise clients across the growing Americas region. You'll take ownership of the technical integration process, ensuring our platform fits seamlessly into each client's ecosystem. As the technical lead for your portfolio, you'll proactively monitor API usage, resolve recurring issues, and manage escalations in close collaboration with our Engineering and Customer Success teams.

You'll lead onboarding design, manage expectations, and deliver consistent value that boosts retention, growth, and satisfaction. In this strategic role, you'll also explore new tech partnerships and integration opportunities that expand our ecosystem and unlock more value for our customers.

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM:**

Our global team of 15+ Technical Account Managers is spread across the world, including EMEA, US, and APAC. We always strive for a seamless client onboarding and bug-free integration, while balancing ever-changing client requests on a daily basis. Our team works closely with Customer Success Managers and the development team, enabling us to act as consultants to all parties involved in the client onboarding journey. Ultimately, handling expectations related to the integration of our platform is where we drive value for our clients & our company.

Our team is defined by our commitment to mutual support and our dedication to deep problem-solving. These qualities are essential in future teammates in order for us to continue building on our strengths.

The estimated total compensation for this role is $115,500, though actual compensation may vary depending on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, certifications, and location. The salary range is subject to change and may be adjusted at any time. For this role, you must be located within commuting distance of one of our US hubs: New York, Chicago, San Francisco, or Boston.

  

**ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:**

* Own the end-to-end technical integration of our API-driven platform into each client's ecosystem
* Troubleshoot recurring technical issues and drive escalations through to resolution
* Manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts, tracking API usage to protect retention, growth, and satisfaction
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and Engineering to deliver a strong client experience
* Design and continuously improve customer onboarding processes
* Identify new technology partnerships and integration opportunities that expand our ecosystem
* Guide customers through expectation-setting conversations that build long-term trust
* Support escalated tickets alongside the broader support team

  

**WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:**

* 4+ years of previous experience working as a Technical Account Manager, Integrations Consultant, , or similar technical client-facing role
* Experience owning API integrations end-to-end for enterprise-level accounts
* Demonstrated ability to successfully handle the demands of Enterprise accounts, including complex stakeholder management
* Proven experience with SaaS based products
* High level of problem-solving attitude in a troubleshooting environment
* Excellent written communication skills with the ability to explain complex topics in easily understood and concise language to both technical and non-technical professionals
* Stay calm, patient, and professional while managing high-stakes customer relationships
* Analytical understanding with a high focus on data-driven decision-making

  

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Learning budget and LinkedIn Learning
* Competitive salaries & 401(k) plan w/match
* Medical, dental, & life insurance
* Flexible PTO
* Mental health support with Nilo.health

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
**About HappyRobot**
--------------------

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly motivated **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to join our growing team. As an SDR, you will play a key role in driving our company’s growth by generating and qualifying new business opportunities.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, research, and engage potential clients through outbound prospecting.
* Manage and maintain an organized pipeline of prospects in the CRM.
* Collaborate with sales and marketing to refine messaging and outreach strategies.
* Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities.
* Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly KPIs for outreach, meetings, and opportunities generated.

**Must have**

* 1-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or a related role (preferably in tech).
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Experience with CRM tools.
* Highly motivated, goal-oriented, and a team player.
* Founder Mindset - You're here for a reason and ready to take risks for something unknown.
* Prior experience in SaaS or a tech startup is a plus.

**Why join us?**
----------------

* Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
* Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
* Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
* Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
* Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

**Our Operating Principles**
----------------------------

***Extreme Ownership***

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

***Craftsmanship***

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

***We are “majos”***  
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

***Urgency with Focus***  
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

***Talent Density and Meritocracy***  
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

***First-Principles Thinking***  
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

* Influence stakeholders without formal authority, knowing when to hold the line and when to compromise.
* Bring deep audience obsession, pressure-testing decisions against what matters to customers.
* Translate complexity into a coherent narrative that connects across touchpoints and compounds over time.
* Operate fluidly across strategy and execution—moving from insight to assignment to strong delivery.

**Overview**

New Jersey’s academic health center, Rutgers Biomedical and Health Sciences (RBHS) takes an integrated approach to educating students, providing clinical care, and conducting research, all with the goal of improving human health. Aligned with Rutgers University–New Brunswick and collaborating universitywide, RBHS includes eight schools, a behavioral health network, and five centers and institutes that focus on cancer treatment and research, neuroscience, advanced biotechnology and medicine, environmental and occupational health, and health care policy and aging research.

Our faculty are teachers, clinicians, and scientists with unparalleled experience who advance medical innovation and provide patient care informed by the latest research findings. jobs.title: Shipping & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Upper East Side, Manhattan, NYC.

**Hours:** Full-time, five days a week, 10:00 – 6:00 (37.5 hours/week). Saturday availability is required.

**Salary:** $50,000

**Reporting to:** Gallery Manager

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a reliable, meticulous and proactive [insert job title here] to join our New York team. This is a hands-on role, and shipping, logistics and operations are the core of it: packing and dispatching rare books and works on paper, handling couriers and customs documentation, keeping detailed shipping logs, moving and caring for stock, preparing for book fairs, and ensuring that the gallery runs smoothly day to day.

The position is entry-level, but we are looking for someone to take real ownership of it. Shipping and operations in New York will be this person's department to run, and there is room to grow as this side of the business expands.

At least one year's experience in shipping, logistics or operations is preferred. Short of that, we will consider candidates who can demonstrate a real interest in the work and a willingness to learn it properly.

**Duties will include, but are not limited to:**

**Shipping & Receiving:**

* Package and prepare books, prints, artworks, and other items for both international and domestic shipping.
* Coordinate with the UK shipping team to prepare shipping labels and supporting documentation for US and international deliveries.
* Liaise with couriers and postal service providers to ensure timely and cost-effective deliveries.
* Deliver goods locally between Peter Harrington New York, bookstores, galleries, auction houses, trade fairs, and clients.
* Log incoming and outgoing goods and maintain accurate, well-organized records.
* Assist with the organization and setup of book fairs, including staffing arrangements and packing and unpacking book fair trunks.
* Apply protective coverings and ensure the appropriate care of incoming and existing stock.
* Perform porterage and internal circulation of items.

**Logistics & Compliance:**

* Manage accounts and relationships with couriers, freight forwarders and postal providers; obtain quotes and ensure deliveries are timely and cost-effective.
* Prepare and check customs documentation for international shipments, including commercial invoices, tariff codes and country-of-origin declarations.
* Arrange transit insurance, ensure values are declared correctly, and handle claims for loss or damage.
* Track consignments through to delivery, resolving delays, customs holds and missing parcels.
* Monitor shipping costs against budget and recommend improvements to carriers, materials or process.
* Maintain and improve the department's procedures and documentation so that shipping runs consistently and can be picked up by others when needed.

**Operations & Facilities:**

* Take day-to-day responsibility for the smooth running of the New York premises.
* Schedule and oversee facilities projects from start to finish with minimal supervision, liaising with contractors and building management.
* Carry out basic repairs and maintenance, and keep the gallery and office presentable — including tidying, dusting, and ad hoc or emergency cleaning.
* Manage the layout and upkeep of office and gallery space: furniture, equipment, storage and removals.
* Maintain inventory of office, kitchen and packing supplies, reordering proactively so that nothing runs out mid-shipment.
* Act as the first point of contact for IT issues on site, liaising with the IT department in London and with external vendors.
* Run occasional business-related errands as required.

**Bookfairs & Events:**

* Prepare stock for fairs: packing and unpacking trunks, preparing lists, and ensuring shipments arrive on schedule.
* Assist with the organisation and set-up of book fairs, including staffing arrangements and stand build.
* Assist with the set-up and coordination of gallery events and other ad hoc activities, liaising with venues and external suppliers.

**Essential Skills and Experience:**

* Previous experience handling, packing, or shipping valuable, fragile, or collectible items.
* Stellar time management skills.
* Meticulous attention to detail.
* Initiative and a proactive approach to responsibilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with strong numeracy.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels.
* Professionalism and confidence when interacting with a diverse range of clients and colleagues.
* Effective team player with a collaborative approach.

**How to Apply:**

Applicants should send their CV and cover letter directly to: recruitment@peterharrington.co.uk .

All applications must include a cover or introduction letter. Please note that applications may not be considered without a letter.

Closing date: 25th October 2026

We will be reviewing applications and scheduling meetings on a rolling basis over the next few weeks, so we recommend applying as soon as possible.

Start date: As soon as possible.

This position requires the ability to lift and carry heavy boxes, averaging 25 lbs, as part of the role's daily responsibilities.

Peter Harrington is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Pay: $50,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Can you work in-person 5 days a week?

Whalar, part of Accenture Song is the leading, most awarded Creator and Social agency. We transform brands into cultural drivers by unlocking the full creative power of Creators.

With hubs in London, Berlin, New York, and Los Angeles, our reach is global.

Learn more: https://www.whalar.com/

**About the role:**
-------------------

Whalar Agency is looking for an Executive Assistant, New Business to be the right hand of our CEO and keep our New York office running smoothly. Reporting to our Chief of Staff, you'll own our CEO's calendar, travel and day-to-day priorities, staying a step ahead so things are handled before anyone has to ask. You'll also run our Wall Street office, making it a welcoming place for our team, clients and guests, and give hands-on support to our Chief of Staff, our client business team and other stakeholders across the business.

**Here's what you'll do day-to-day:**
-------------------------------------

* Own our CEO's complex, high-volume calendar, balancing competing priorities and sharing a weekly look-ahead so nothing catches them off guard.
* Plan travel for our CEO as soon as commitments are confirmed, laying out options and managing itineraries and logistics, including some personal and family travel arrangements and errands.
* Manage every client and guest visit from start to finish: registering guests with the building, welcoming them in the lobby and making sure meeting rooms are set up and ready.
* Run daily reception, making a great first impression on clients, guests and partners.
* Act as office manager for our Wall Street office: keep it well stocked and welcoming, coordinate vendors and catering, and organize team breakfasts, lunches and happy hours.
* Support our Chief of Staff, client business team and other senior stakeholders as needed, from office and team logistics to client setup, room bookings and expense reports. Occasionally support travel needs.
* Secure high-priority restaurant reservations and coordinate client dinners and event hospitality.
* Research upcoming meeting participants and key stakeholders on LinkedIn, and build structured attendee lookbooks ahead of external meetings and events.
* On occasion help prepare for Creator panels hosted by our leaders, including drafting questions that play to each Creator's strengths.

----------------------------------

* Significant experience supporting a C-suite executive, including managing a complex calendar and travel.
* A proactive, anticipatory approach: you spot what's needed and handle it before you're asked, and you only need to be shown something once.
* Calm, sound judgment under pressure, with experience in fast-paced, high-stakes environments such as consulting, finance, tech or agencies.
* Experience running an office or front of house, with a hospitality-oriented mindset and confidence as the first point of contact for clients, guests and senior stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle shifting priorities across several people without losing track of details.
* High discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential business information and personal or family details.
* Confidence with digital research, especially LinkedIn, and with turning what you find into clear, well-organized materials.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication.

This role is based in our Wall Street, NY office, where you'll work on-site four days a week, Monday through Thursday. Being in the room with our leadership team is at the heart of this role, and you'll have the flexibility to work from home when our leaders are traveling or calendar demands allow.

The salary range for this role is $110,000 - $130,000 and serves as a general guideline for the potential compensation. The final salary offer will be determined based on a comprehensive evaluation of factors such as the candidate's experience, expertise, alignment with the position's requirements, location, and, ultimately, budget approvals.

**Our values:**

A diverse team and inclusive leadership have shaped Whalar since our inception in 2016, fueling a constant evolution of growth. jobs.title: Capital Project Coordinator - Housing and Residence Life Department
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

  

**Overview**

Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our strategic plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work-life balance and is aware that attracting Faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers.

  

**About Georgia Tech**

Georgia Tech is a top-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's Faculty attracted more than $1.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and is No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.

  

**Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

1. Students are our top priority.

2. We strive for excellence.

3. We thrive on diversity.

4. We celebrate collaboration.

5. We champion innovation.

6. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.

7. We nurture the well-being of our community.

8. We act ethically.

9. We are responsible stewards.

  

Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good, breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.

**Department Information**
--------------------------

  

Housing and Residence Life is passionate about the Georgia Tech residential student experience. With 97% of all first-year students choosing to live on campus, we create spaces and opportunities for Yellow Jackets to grow and connect from their first day of college through their graduate studies. We are proud to support our students' personal development and academic endeavors while providing a safe and comfortable living environment.

  

Our department is a large and complex organization supporting over 8,700 on-campus residents among 49 traditional, suite, and apartment-style residence halls, some of which were constructed for the 1996 Summer Olympics. Our team of 200+ professional staff and 300+ student staff from six units supports residents directly and indirectly with their unique talents. We are housed within the C**ampus Services** division, which includes many student service offices.

  

**Mission**

Housing and Residence Life creates caring, connected communities through competitively priced, well-maintained living spaces. We support students in building a strong foundation for their Georgia Tech experience, helping them feel seen, supported, and ready to thrive both personally and academically.

**Job Summary**

This role supports calendar management, meeting and event coordination, communications, research support, and follow-up on priorities and action items. The Administrative Coordinator also partners with team members to maintain consistency across deliverables, prepare presentations and reports, and support weekly team rhythms. Success in this role requires strong organization, sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy, professionalism, and responsiveness in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

**Administrative & Operational Support**

* Provide day-to-day administrative support for Talent Acquisition senior leaders, including calendar coordination, meeting scheduling, and logistics for team meetings, offsites, and events.
* Prepare and distribute agendas, materials, and follow-up communications, and track action items to support timely completion.
* Support team rhythms, including weekly meetings, through preparation, facilitation support, note capture, and follow-up .
* Maintain organized digital files, shared resources, and documentation to ensure accessibility, accuracy, and consistency.
* Manage administrative processes from intake through completion, ensuring accuracy, timely execution, and proactive follow-up.
* Resolve routine administrative issues independently and escalate items needing attention with clear context and recommended next steps.
* Arrange all aspects of TA leadership travel.

**Coordination & Communication**

* Serve as a point of coordination for internal stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, seamless handoffs, and timely follow-up.
* Draft, format, and distribute internal communications, presentations, and materials aligned with excellence standards.
* Support leader preparation for meetings, presentations, and engagements through research, material preparation and logistics support.
* Maintain consistency across administrative processes, tools, and templates for the Talent Acquisition team.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve ways of working and increase team efficiency.
* Build strong working relationships across teams to support collaboration, trust, and effective partnerships.
