* Serve as the Talent Acquisition departmental on-boarding culture champion.
* Support leaders/team in delivering moments of care-e.g. birthdays, anniversaries, births, etc.

**Financial & Logistical Support**

* Maintain TA budget in partnership with the TA enablement partner.
* Provide support for expenses, invoices, travel coordination, purchasing, and budget tracking in alignment with enterprise processes and expense guidelines.

**General Team Support**

* Model professionalism, responsiveness, and care in all interactions.
* Exercise sound judgment and discretion, including appropriately directing meeting requests and other requests for leader time.
* Lead Talent Acquisition project work as assigned. Participate in Talent Acquisition cross-functional teams as appropriate.

Required Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities):

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, and Word
* Experience in administrative, coordination, or operational support roles
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
* Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and discretion
* Experience coordinating meetings, travel and team events
* Ability to improve workflows and maintain consistent team processes

Preferred Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities):

* Strong written communication and presentation formatting skills
* Experience supporting multiple leaders or a fast-paced team environment
* Experience supporting business operations in a corporate or professional services environment
* Willingness to learn new tools, systems, and ways of working

Location: Atlanta, United States Job reference: R-261579 Date posted: 10/09/2026

**About the job:**

The Regional Account Manager (RAM) position is within our Rare Hematology and Nephrology Franchise, a division of Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease and will focus on the launch of IgAN as a potential new indication. The RAM will be assigned a sales territory focused on academic centers, community hospital systems, physician clinics, infusion centers, and other strategic sites of care, focused on nephrology. This individual would be responsible for the growth and expansion of the IgAN indication while supporting appropriate assigned indication opportunities with key nephrology customers.

**Why Join Us?**At Alexion, we’re united by a shared purpose: to transform the lives of people affected by rare diseases. In Neurology, that purpose is personal. We connect deeply with patients and their care teams, and we work together to deliver innovative therapies that make a real difference. Here, your work means more—more impact, more growth, and more connection.**What You’ll Do**As a Regional Account Manager – Rare Nephrology, you’ll build trusted relationships with healthcare professionals across your territory. You’ll represent Alexion’s nephrology indications, helping providers understand our therapies and how they support patients with rare nephrological conditions.**Territory Includes:** Atlanta, Macon, Columbus, GA.Must live within the geography.

**You will:**

* Consistently achieve or exceed sales objectives in assigned territory
* Create and maintain strategically targeted account-specific business plans that reflect an in-depth understanding of local market forces impacting product sales, diagnostic pathways, referral patterns, and treatment adoption.
* Develop and maintain strong, in-depth clinical, technical, and scientific knowledge across assigned indications, with emphasis on renal disease education and the needs of nephrology customers.
* Demonstrate the ability to educate on the clinical approach to relevant disease states, leading to successful differential diagnosis, appropriate testing, and timely treatment of focus patient populations.
* Build and maintain productive relationships with nephrologists and other key stakeholders in academic centers, community hospital systems, physician clinics, infusion centers, and related sites of care.

* Handle customer questions and objections in a way that is consistent with product indications and sales training methodology, including the ability to compliantly triage inquiries to the appropriate partner.
* Understand and demonstrate proper use of products to clinicians in hospital, clinic, and infusion center environments.
* Lead the implementation of a patient-centric partnership model that includes physicians, their staff, patients, clinics, hospitals, and relevant care partners.
* Effectively utilize CRM tools to manage territory priorities, track account engagement, document sales activities, and submit required reports accurately and on time; and adopt CRM AI-embedded tools to prioritize opportunities and optimize call execution
* Effectively use AI-driven insights for territory planning, HCP targeting, and pre-call strategy; translate analytics into focused customer engagement and account action plans
* Execute local promotional activities and programs for the assigned therapeutic areas.
* Provide a high level of product expertise and customer service to all accounts.
* Proactively interact with Alexion management to refine product and market initiatives based on field insights, access trends, and account needs.
* Perform work in alignment with and adhering to Alexion’s Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and Alexion policies and procedures.

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 5 years pharmaceutical sales or equivalent experience (e.g., Biotech or Medical Device), or 5 years of experience in a medical setting.
* Proven, documented track record for delivering consistent, top-tier sales results in institutions, hospital systems, and/or complex specialty markets.
* Ability to work independently as well as interdependently in a team-oriented environment.
* Strong clinical acumen, account-based selling, analytical, and strategic skills to successfully develop accounts.
* Demonstrated ability to seek out and qualify leads, profile new accounts, and build durable relationships with relevant healthcare providers and office staff.
* Ability to gain consistent access and develop strong, professional relationships for scientific exchange and promotion with healthcare providers in community and academic settings.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational abilities.
* Must live in the geographic territory or live within 50 miles of the geographic territory border.
* Ability to travel within territory on a regular basis, which may include frequent overnight and weekend travel.
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
* The duties of this role are generally conducted in a field environment. As is typical of a field-based role, employees must be able, with or without an accommodation, to travel by public transportation, automobile, train, or plane; work comfortably in a clinical setting; use a computer; engage in communications via phone, video, and electronic messaging; problem solve; engage in complex and non-linear thought, analysis, and dialogue; collaborate with others; and maintain general availability during standard business hours.

* Advanced or master’s degree.

jobs.title: Account Manager Commercial Lines
jobs.description:
**About Acrisure**

A global fintech leader, Acrisure empowers millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human support together, we connect clients with customized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services – and more.

In the last twelve years, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to almost $5 billion and employs over 19,000 colleagues in more than 20 countries. Acrisure was built on entrepreneurial spirit. Prioritizing leadership, accountability, and collaboration, we equip our teams to work at the highest levels possible.

**About The Role**

The Commercial Lines Account Manager will have a primary responsibility for policy maintenance and service of an assigned portion of accounts. Maintain a high level of client retention by managing the day-to-day service needs of our clients and constantly work toward strong client relationships. Market and service accounts in accordance with the platform objectives and procedures. Contribute to the profitable growth of the platform by achieving retention and renewal goals, proactive account rounding, up-selling of limits/coverages and by providing extraordinary client service.

**Responsibilities:**

* Establish and maintains a strong relationship and assists the client advisors in making decisions on account updates and coverage for accounts with moderate complexities.
* Collaborate with the client advisor to review exposures and insurance programs for assigned clients, determine if carrier is the best fit for the client while considering coverage, protection, and cost.
* Collaborate with client advisors to market, quote, and prepare the proposal for the client from both a risk management and insurance prospective to decide upon the “best” way to manage the customer’s risk.
* Provide day-to-day service, anticipate customer’s needs, and respond to client issues/questions in a timely manner.
* Handles initial report of claims and following up to ensure that the claim is properly progressing, and customer’s needs are being met.
* Monitor carrier activities to make sure that they are fulfilling their responsibilities to the customer (policy endorsements, claims, etc.).
* Complete account reviews.
* Attempt to round-out each customer’s insurance portfolio including, the solicitation of additional commercial and personal lines insurance where applicable and maintain customer records in accordance with procedures.
* Keeps customers up to date on “pending changes” in the insurance world that may impact their insurance coverage.
* Assists or completes other tasks as directed by platform management.
* Provide timely, professional, accurate communication to client, team, and carrier representatives.
* Keep and maintain confidentiality of client records and communication.
* Seeks referrals from clients and follows through to help generate new business.
* Refers current and prospective clients to Benefits Department and Personal Insurance for solicitation of those lines of business.
* Coach and mentor junior members of the commercial lines, may lead team meetings and initiatives.
* Comply with agency standards, policies, and procedures.

*\*This description is not meant to be all-inclusive and may be modified from time to time at the discretion of management\**

**Requirements:**

* Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills including correct grammar, spelling, and punctuation in correspondence.
* Must have a high level of understanding accounting or strong math skills.
* High degree of critical thinking; ability to problem solve when the answer is not readily apparent.
* Demonstrated attention to detail, producing outcomes with minimal errors.
* Ability to adapt well to change in direction and priority in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to demonstrate advanced level proficiency with a variety of technology including MS Office
* Knowledge of Agency Management Systems; Applied Epic a plus.
* Able to function independently and as part of a team.
* Complies with continuing education requirements for agent licensing as well as professional designations.
* Keeps informed regarding industry information, new production information, coverages, and technology to continually improve knowledge and stay current.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree’s degree and/or 5+ years commercial insurance experience or recognized equivalent is required.
* Hold and maintain appropriate state Property and Casualty Insurance License.
* Initiate, obtain, and maintain (CISR elite, CIC, or other advanced designations).

**Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership.**

**Why Join Us:**

At Acrisure, we’re building more than a business, we’re building a community where people can grow, thrive, and make an impact. Our benefits are designed to support every dimension of your life, from your health and finances to your family and future.

Making a lasting impact on the communities it serves, Acrisure has pledged more than $22 million through its partnerships with Corewell Health Helen DeVos Children's Hospital in Grand Rapids, Michigan, UPMC Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and Blythedale Children's Hospital in Valhalla, New York.

* **Physical Wellness:** Comprehensive medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; fertility benefits; wellness resources; and paid sick time.
* **Mental Wellness:** Generous paid time off and holidays; Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and a complimentary Calm app subscription.

Overview:

When you think of InComm Payments, think of Innovative Payments Technology. We were founded over 30 years ago and continue to be a pioneer in the payment (FinTech) industry. Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. We own over 400 global technical patents and a network that includes over 525,000 points of retail distribution that points to our industry expertise.

InComm Payments works with the most recognized and valued brands in the world, and we are partnered with most of the world’s leading merchants. InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity, and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram.

  
About This Opportunity:

We’re looking for a strategic, results-driven **Manager** with strong leadership experience in account management and a solid background in loyalty marketing and product development. In this role, you’ll lead client relationships, drive cross-functional growth initiatives, and help shape loyalty and rewards strategy in support of a large, broad portfolio of strategic clients within InComm InCentives.

The business unit is focused on delivering innovative loyalty and incentive solutions to business customers, and it is one of the fastest growing areas of InComm. The **Manager I** will lead a team and liaise with key internal and external stakeholders to drive strategic account growth plans; this includes maximizing opportunities that deliver incremental sales of prepaid products and other InComm solutions; expanding our product offering within top accounts; identifying revenue-generating marketing and promotional initiatives; and other business building activities.

Direct Report responsibility includes managing employee growth and development, as well as providing oversight of each individual’s account portfolio. We are looking for someone who can be a great motivator and encourager of Account Managers.

Responsibilities:

* Manage a team of 3 - 5 account managers and associate account managers, subject to change based on business needs.
* Work with team on day-to-day support and strategic execution of account goals, including contract negotiations, operational needs, and special projects.
* Build and strengthen client relationships and serve as a primary point of contact for InComm, including as an escalation point for direct reports, customers and other teams.
* Create and execute against a professional development plan for direct reports
* Provide thought leadership on strategic initiatives, which includes data-driven insights and recommendations.
* Build and strengthen relationships within internal stakeholders and collaborate with internal team members effectively to achieve desired results
* Ability to grow account revenue through activities such as product expansion, promotional opportunities and program implementations
* Subject matter expert on technology solutions used by customer to ensure the best experience possible
* Identify growth opportunities and collaborate with product and tech teams to expand and enhance InComm InCentive product solutions.
* Penetrate accounts by selling in new and additional products and building relationships with the key decision makers within accounts
* 20% Travel, client visits and tradeshow attendance as directed by Senior Director of Account Management.

Qualifications:  

* BA/BS or 8+ years account management experience.
* Background in account management, loyalty and rewards marketing and/or product development.
* A strong record of achievement, client retention and growth
* Experience managing medium to large national accounts in a technology or software company preferred.
* Experience recruiting, developing and coaching direct reports to achieve maximum potential with department goals as well as conducting performance reviews
* Comfortable learning new technology/product lines in a highly innovative environment and training direct reports
* Superior relationship management skills including ability to engage in strategic conversations with all levels of management
* Proven ability to create and implement strategic plans
* Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and customer service orientation.
* Creative thinking and problem-solving skills to determine the best path forward in an environment where multiple solutions are possible.
* Demonstrated leadership in a team environment
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment
* Aptitude for thinking and acting on a strategic and tactical level
* Excellent presentation and negotiation skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and other computer skills.
* Knowledge of gift card products and fulfillment a plus

**Job Description**
===================

  

**Position Summary**

Momentive Software is seeking a motivated and curious **Business Development Representative (BDR)** to join our Atlanta team. This role is designed for **recent college graduates** or individuals **new to the professional workforce** who are excited to learn the foundations of sales, grow quickly, and make a meaningful impact.

  

**Job Description**

As a BDR, you will learn how to **qualify inbound leads** , **prospect for new clients** , and introduce Momentive Software’s solutions to nonprofit and association organizations. You’ll connect with potential customers, understand their needs, and schedule high‑quality meetings for our sales team.

This is a great fit if you enjoy talking with people, are eager to build professional skills, and want a clear path to grow your career.

Momentive provides extensive training, structured enablement, and hands‑on coaching from experienced leaders. We are deeply committed to developing early‑career talent and promoting from within — many of our most successful sales professionals started in this role.

**A Day in the Life**

* **Qualify inbound leads** by responding quickly, asking thoughtful questions, and determining fit

* **Prospect for new clients** through outreach such as cold calling, email campaigns, social selling, and networking

* Conduct research using tools like ZoomInfo to identify key contacts and understand target organizations

* Engage potential customers in friendly, consultative conversations to identify challenges and match them to Momentive Software solutions

* Schedule discovery calls or demos for the sales team

* Collaborate with your manager and teammates to learn best practices for outreach, messaging, and pipeline building

* Keep accurate notes and activity details in **Salesforce**

Build confidence in understanding nonprofit and association industry needs and how our products support them  



**What You Bring**

**Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in **Microsoft Office** (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)

* Clear, professional communication skills — written and verbal

* Interest in learning sales and building a long‑term career in a customer‑facing role

**Characteristics**

* Curious and eager to learn new skills

* Proactive self‑starter with a positive, can‑do attitude

* Resilient when facing challenges or rejection

* Strong critical thinking and problem‑solving abilities

* High attention to detail and good organizational habits

* Comfortable talking to new people and building relationships

Team player who enjoys contributing to a supportive, collaborative environment  



**Work Environment & Flexibility**

This role follows a **hybrid work schedule** based at our office in Atlanta ( 3495 Piedmont Rd., NE, Atlanta, Ga. ):

* **Onsite:** Tuesday–Thursday

* **Remote:** Monday & Friday

This structure supports team collaboration, coaching, and hands‑on learning — all essential for early‑career success.

**Office Perks & Amenities**

* Free covered parking with EV charging

* Complimentary fitness center

* On‑site car wash and dry cleaning

* 2+ miles of scenic walking trails

* Lobby café with healthy grab‑and‑go options and a full coffee bar

**About Us**
============

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com .

**Why Work Here?**

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

jobs.title: B2B Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**B2B Inside Sales Representative, Edible Arrangements**

**Who are we and what do we do?**

Edible Brands® was launched in 2022 to bring together powerful, purpose-led brands under one unified purpose: to enrich everyday life through celebration, nourishment, and wellness. Today, Edible Brands powers bold and growing concepts across 600+ locations worldwide.

Our portfolio spans Edible Arrangements®, the iconic gifting brand; Rōti®, a Mediterranean-inspired fast-casual restaurant; and BerryDirect®, our robust supply chain infrastructure. Together, these brands are fueled by *The Edible Brands Way*—a set of employee-driven values that keep us committed, collaborative, adaptable, results-driven, and always ready to celebrate.

**The Big Picture:**

As the Inside Sales Representative on Edible Arrangements Corporate Gifting Sales team, you’ll play a key role in helping to launch and grow our new business gifting program. Reporting directly to the Director of Corporate Gifting, you’ll be responsible for building strong relationships with business clients, understanding their gifting needs, and recommending the right Edible solutions when gifting employees, clients, and partners. You’ll use data-driven outreach, a service-first mindset, and a passion for helping others to drive sales, create loyal customers, and establish the foundation for a scalable, high-impact B2B sales channel.

**Location:** This position will work onsite out of our Corporate Office in Sandy Springs, GA Monday – Friday, with limited travel when necessary.

**What that looks like day to day:**

* Prospect and qualify new business customers through outbound calling, email outreach, and LinkedIn engagement.
* Use sales data and client insights to identify trends, think critically about new business opportunities, and creatively craft new outreach approaches or seasonal campaigns.
* Present tailored sales proposals for client gifting needs such as employee appreciation, holiday gifting, client thank-yous, and event-based campaigns.
* Manage the full sales cycle from initial contact to closing the deal, including follow-up, negotiation, and coordination with fulfillment teams.
* Develop and maintain a rolling sales pipeline, consistently working to move prospects through the funnel and increase conversion rates.
* Meet and exceed monthly quotas for outreach activity, closed revenue, and repeat business from B2B customers.
* Track all interactions and opportunities with high attention to detail and accurate forecasting.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations and the Innovation teams to ensure seamless delivery and exceptional client experiences.
* Identify opportunities for recurring programs and annual gifting campaigns, converting one-time buyers into repeat corporate clients.
* Represent the Edible Arrangements voice and values, delivering an experience that celebrates both our clients and their gift recipients.

**What you bring:**

* 1–3 years of B2B inside sales experience, ideally in corporate gifting, CPG, or a high-activity outbound sales environment.
* Proven success managing the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals remotely via phone, email, and virtual meetings.
* Hands-on experience tracking pipeline, forecasting, and performance metrics.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity — experience working in a startup, new business unit, or early-stage sales program with evolving processes highly preferred
* Exposure to building or refining sales processes, feedback loops, or playbooks to help shape a new sales operation from the ground up.

**How you work:**

* Self-starter mindset – thrives in an environment with limited structure and takes initiative without waiting to be told what to do.
* Curiosity and creativity – naturally seeks out new business opportunities, thinks outside the box, and tailors solutions to customer needs.
* Strong communication skills – able to build trust quickly over the phone and in writing, and represent the Edible professionally.
* Agility and adaptability – able to pivot when needed, iterate quickly on messaging, and stay focused as the program evolves.
* Team-oriented but independent – enjoys collaborating cross-functionally, while still owning personal targets and daily workflow.

**What We Offer:**

* Strong team-oriented environment, emphasizing cross-functional partnerships
* The stability and resources of an industry-leading company successfully operating for 25 years, with the agility and innovation of a startup, allowing you to make a significant impact and shape our future.
* Growth & Development – Each team member has a visible and immediate impact on the business, offering abundant opportunities for personal and professional growth as we scale in size and sophistication
* Healthcare plans that include health/dental/vision insurance, 401K Plan, company-paid life insurance and short-term disability, flexible spending account options and more
* Paid time off, including sick days & holidays to support work-life balance

*We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer. Applicants for employment are considered without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, and disability, or veteran status.*

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About IconicCare**

IconicCare places an in-house physiatrist in skilled nursing facilities at no cost to the facility. Our providers

are in the building 2–3 days a week, focused on pain management, function, and skin integrity. That means

patients hit their discharge function goals, opioid use comes down, and falls and hospital readmissions drop.

We were founded by physiatrist Dr. Christian Morris, and we're growing quickly into new markets.

**The role**

You'll own the greater Atlanta metro. You'll visit skilled nursing facilities across the metro, build relationships with

Administrators and Directors of Nursing, and set up alignment calls with Dr. Morris and our Director of

Revenue Operations. You don't need a clinical background, because Dr. Morris handles the clinical

conversation on the call. Your job is building trust in the building and getting the right people on the

calendar.

Because this is a home territory, you'll be back in the same buildings regularly. Those who do best here

turn a front-desk hello into a first-name relationship with the DON.

If you're picturing struggling to get past the front desk and getting shown the door, this is the opposite. Facilities need

what we have. In-house physiatry is in high demand and hard to find, and most buildings have been trying to

get this kind of coverage for a long time. When you walk in, you're not selling something. You're a partner to our

clinical team, helping facilities get the care their patients need.

When it's done right, staff don't see you as a marketer. They see you as part of the clinical care team, someone

who understands their challenges and connects them with Dr. Morris for the full clinical picture. Doors open

easily, and getting in front of the Administrator and Director of Nursing in person is usually the easy part.

**Who we want (and who we don't)**

We want people who learn quickly and are incredibly friendly/personable. We'll teach you the industry.

We are intentionally not looking for marketing reps from wound care, therapy, hospice, or other SNF vendor

companies. We want a different kind of presence in these buildings, not the one administrators already hear from

every week. You need to be good at following a system, keeping notes, and making friends.

**What you'll do**

* Repeatedly visit a set route of facilities across your metro.
* Build repeat relationships with front desk staff, Administrators, and DONs
* Set up alignment calls with both the Administrator and the DON attending
* Log every visit and meeting in HubSpot
* Keep a clean pipeline so every booked call is ready for a smooth handoff

**Full-time or part-time:**

You choose whether to work full-time or part-time. Full-time reps are eligible for company benefits,

including health, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k). Part-time reps set a schedule that fits their life

and can still choose any of the three pay plans below. On a plan with a base salary, the base is prorated to

the time you work each month, and your bonus rates stay the same as a full-time employee on that plan.

**Choose how you're paid**

Everyone comes into this role with different goals, and life circumstances, so you choose how you're paid. We offer three

compensation plans, and every one is built around a $100,000 on target annual income for full-time employees:

* **Full Commission**. The highest commission rates and the most upside, for reps who want every dollar tied

to their results.

* **Base + commission**. A guaranteed base salary with reduced commission rates, for steadier income while

you build your territory.

* **Partial Base + commission**. A smaller base with commission rates in between, for a balance of stability and upside.

On every plan, you get paid at multiple stages as a facility moves forward, from the first initial meeting through

signing. Commission is uncapped, and top performers earn well past the on target earning of $100,000. We'll walk through the exact numbers for each plan in your interview.

**Mileage & Travel**: reimbursed at company rate

**Requirements**

* Reliable vehicle and valid driver's license
* Able to pass a background check and meet facility visitor requirements
* A professional, trustworthy, kind presence in a healthcare setting

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
50,000 - 150,000 USD per year(Atlanta, GA)

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Aerovy**
================

Aerovy is the operating layer for hardware OEMs. We take the signals coming off equipment in mobility, industrial, material handling, and construction, and normalize them into one model for assets, components, health, and events that holds across brands and model years.

With Aerovy, OEMs:

* **Launch an AI ecosystem for their hardware:** branded apps a manufacturer puts in front of its own customers, from the app that comes with the machine to connected services and subscription tiers
* **Elevate aftermarket service:** the machine reports a fault, it's diagnosed, the right technician is dispatched with the right part, and the job is closed out and reported. First-time fix rates go up; time to acknowledgement and time to response come down
* **Cut warranty cost and service spend:** predictive failure detection, automated triage, and AI-driven root-cause across their install base

We're a fast-paced startup building the digital infrastructure for the next generation of intelligent hardware. Founded in 2023 as a spinoff of research from Purdue University, we've grown from 5 full-time workers at the end of 2025 to 13 today, with ARR up 4x+ over the same period. We're backed by institutional VCs from Mudita Venture Partners, M25, Quorum Capital Partners, Knoll Ventures, and Purdue Ventures, and angels from Google, Tesla, Intel, Siemens +more.

**The role**
============

As the first Business Development Representative at Aerovy, you’ll report directly to the CEO. The job has two halves. The first is outbound: working the 120-account named list to find the right person at the right OEM and get them into a qualified first meeting. The second is pipeline support: the CEO is personally carrying live enterprise deals, and you make sure none of them stall. Follow-ups go out on time, next steps get booked, HubSpot reflects reality, and conference meetings are on the calendar before we land.

Most BDR seats stop at the meeting. This one doesn’t. You stay on a deal through close. We’re looking for someone who treats a VP of Aftermarket’s calendar as a puzzle to solve, writes a clean email, and would rather own a number than a task list.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Run outbound against the named-account list: research the account, identify the aftermarket and digital stakeholders, build sequences in Apollo, and book qualified meetings.
* Qualify to our standard before handoff: a champion, a next meeting on the calendar, and a number the buyer put on the problem.
* Own follow-through on the CEO’s direct pipeline: send recaps, chase open items, schedule the next step, and keep every deal moving between meetings.
* Keep HubSpot current: contacts, deal stages, Sourced by and Qualified properties, and the notes a teammate would need to pick up the deal cold.
* Pre-book meetings for trade shows and conferences, build the onsite schedule, and run post-show follow-up within the week.
* Put sales automation and AI to work on account research, list building, and personalization so one person can cover a list this size.
* Prep the CEO for calls: who’s in the room, what they said last time, what we need out of the meeting.
* Feed what you hear in outbound back to marketing: which messages land, which objections repeat, which titles reply.
* Write down what works so the next BDR starts from your process.

**Job Requirements**

* 1 to 3 years in a BDR, SDR, or sales support role selling B2B software, or a track record of persistent, organized outreach from another field.
* Written communication that’s clear and short; you can draft a cold email a VP would actually read.
* Comfort on the phone and in person, including walking a trade show floor and opening conversations cold.
* Organized to a fault: you keep a CRM clean without being asked and nothing falls through between meetings.
* Fluency with HubSpot, Apollo, or similar prospecting and CRM tools, and curiosity about using AI to do more of the work.
* Coachable and low ego: you’ll be running someone else’s playbook before you improve it.
* Based in Atlanta or able to be in the office regularly, with travel to conferences and customer sites.

**Nice to Haves**

* Exposure to manufacturing, industrial equipment, fleet, or aftermarket and field service
* You’ve supported an enterprise deal from first meeting through signature and can describe what you did to keep it moving
* Experience planning or working trade shows

**Additional Notes**

* This role is based in Atlanta, with travel to conferences and customer sites.

Compensation Range: $55K - $80K

jobs.description:
This Is Not a Maintenance Role

Amnex Solutions is looking for a high-output Drayage Account Manager who can take ownership of demanding customer accounts, move freight under pressure, protect profitability, and create growth.

We are not looking for someone who simply forwards emails, updates spreadsheets, or waits for instructions. We need someone who anticipates problems, makes decisions, drives communication, and treats every account like a business within the business.

If a container is approaching last free day, you are already working on the solution. If a carrier falls off, you immediately coordinate recovery. If a customer has additional freight, you recognize the opportunity and pursue it. You do not wait for problems—or revenue—to find you.

**About Amnex Solutions**

Amnex Solutions Corp is one of the fastest-growing 4PLs in the country, specializing in drayage, intermodal, and OTR transportation throughout the United States.

Founded in January 1, 2024 by transportation professionals with more than 16 years of industry experience, Amnex has grown at an extraordinary pace by solving problems others cannot, responding faster than the competition, and holding its team to an uncompromising standard of execution.

We are building a dominant national logistics organization—not a comfortable, slow-moving brokerage. The people who join us now will have the opportunity to help shape the company, build major customer accounts, and grow into leadership positions as we continue expanding.

**The Mission**

As a Drayage Account Manager, you will take command of assigned customer accounts from order acceptance through final delivery, empty return, documentation, and billing.

Your mission is straightforward:

Keep containers moving.  

Keep customers informed.  
Eliminate preventable accessorials.  
Protect and improve margins.  
Solve problems before they escalate.  
Expand the accounts under your control.  

You will have support from carrier sales, tracking, accounting, and company leadership—but ownership of the account belongs to you.

**What You Will Own**

**Customer Accounts**

Serve as the primary point of contact and operational authority for assigned customers.  

Learn each customer’s business, facilities, SOPs, priorities, and service expectations.  
Provide fast, accurate, and proactive communication without making customers chase you for updates.  
Build enough trust that customers bring additional lanes, locations, and projects directly to you.  
Identify weaknesses in the customer’s transportation network and present Amnex solutions.  
Turn excellent execution into measurable account growth.  

**Drayage Execution**

Manage import and export container shipments through ports, rail terminals, warehouses, distribution centers, and customer facilities.  

Confirm releases, availability, last free days, appointments, equipment requirements, customs status, delivery requirements, and empty-return instructions.  
Track every shipment through pickup, delivery, empty return, documentation, and financial closeout.  
Monitor demurrage, detention, per diem, storage, chassis usage, and other accessorial exposure.  
Prevent avoidable charges through aggressive follow-up, planning, and escalation.  
Build recovery plans when appointments fail, terminals close, containers are unavailable, carriers fall off, or customer requirements change.  
Maintain accurate and complete shipment information in Turvo.  

**Profitability and Growth**

Understand the revenue, cost, margin, and risk associated with every shipment.  

Protect margins while maintaining the service required to retain and grow the account.  
Challenge unnecessary costs and identify operational inefficiencies.  
Work with carrier sales to develop dedicated capacity and stronger pricing.  
Recognize expansion opportunities and actively pursue additional customer volume.  
Treat assigned accounts as businesses that must become larger, stronger, and more profitable over time.  

**Carrier Coordination**

Partner with the carrier sales team to secure reliable capacity at competitive rates.  

Build productive relationships with high-performing drayage carriers and dispatch teams.  
Confirm rates, appointments, equipment, driver information, terminal access, and service requirements before dispatch.  
Ensure carriers meet Amnex insurance, safety, compliance, and onboarding standards.  
Hold carriers accountable for communication, documentation, and service performance.  
Help develop dedicated capacity for recurring lanes and major projects.  

**Documentation and Financial Closeout**

Collect PODs, interchange receipts, gate tickets, scale tickets, lumper receipts, invoices, and other required documents.  

Confirm that accessorial charges are valid, documented, and communicated promptly.  
Maintain complete shipment records so accounting can bill customers and pay carriers accurately.  
Resolve missing documentation, rate discrepancies, and outstanding charges before they delay closeout.  

**The Standard**

At Amnex, strong performance means more than keeping up with email.

A successful Drayage Account Manager:

Knows the status and next action for every active shipment.  

Communicates problems before the customer discovers them.  
Moves quickly without sacrificing accuracy.  
Takes ownership instead of passing responsibility.  
Follows through until every issue is completely resolved.  
Maintains control when operations become chaotic.  
Protects the company’s reputation and profitability.  
Consistently expands the value of assigned accounts.  
Raises the performance of the people around them.  

**Required Qualifications**

Our global network of colleagues, located in offices and manufacturing facilities around the world, deliver sustainable value-added solutions to our customers. We are recognized for our deep expertise, commitment to excellence, and bold innovation, which have earned us a strong reputation as a trusted industry leader.

Wherever your career is headed, you’ll find direction, opportunity, and belonging with us.

**Intercompany Sales Account Manager**

**Department:** Sales, Distribution  
**Location: Itasca, IL**  
**Type:** Full Time

**Job Overview**

The Intercompany Sales Account Manager is responsible for managing all aspects of intercompany sales. This role involves building and nurturing relationships with intercompany channels (e.g. Nagase, Nutrition, Solutions), driving revenue growth, and expanding market share. The Intercompany Sales Account Manager will collaborate closely with internal teams to develop and execute strategic sales plans that align with Prinova's business objectives.

**Main Duties & Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary commercial contact for assigned intercompany customers and business units.
* Understand intercompany business objectives, product needs, forecasts, and growth opportunities.
* Conducts at minimum monthly meetings to review current state, future demand, and address issues, etc.
* Introduce new products, suppliers, technologies, and ingredient solutions based on intercompany needs.
* Partner with product management and sourcing teams to establish competitive pricing.
* Ensure pricing and commercial agreements are accurately documented and communicated.
* Coordinate with supply chain and purchasing to minimize stock-outs and excess inventory.
* Communicate anticipated supply disruptions and develop contingency plans.
* Act as the liaison between sales, purchasing, product management, operations, quality, regulatory, logistics, and finance.
* Maintain strong knowledge of nutritional ingredients, applications, functionality, specifications, and market trends.
* Stay current on emerging ingredients, formulation trends, regulatory considerations, and competitive products.
* Understand the differences between commodity, specialty, and value-added nutritional ingredients.
* Serve as an escalation point for significant intercompany concerns.
* Coordinate corrective actions and communicate resolutions in a timely manner.
* Maintain a high level of responsiveness and accountability.

**Requirements and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Minimum 2+ year’s sales experience in the food, beverage, nutritional or sports nutrition industry degree

**Work Conditions & Physical Requirements**

* Ability to lift up to 10 pounds
* Work environment is normally in an office setting. Must be able to make frequent rounds in a warehouse environment
* Ability to view a computer screen and type for extended hours
* Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time
* Other physical requirements include moderate standing and occasional squatting, bending, and twisting.
* Ability to work around a variety of different smells and aromas
* Ability to adjust work schedule as business needs require

**What’s in it for you?**

Competitive Pay – $76,000- $91,000 annually

*Experience, education, geographic location and shift all taken into consideration.*

jobs.description:
The **Customer Account Manager** is responsible for driving both the strategic growth and operational excellence of existing brokerage customers. This role combines commercial account management and shipper experience oversight, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction, account growth, and operational performance. This position reports to the Director of Brokerage Operations.

  

* Develop and manage strong, multi-level shipper relationships (3x3 coverage) to ensure long-term retention and account expansion.
* Drive organic revenue growth by identifying opportunities to increase volume, margin, and service adoption across FTL, LTL, and Intermodal modes.
* Deliver a high-level operational performance in alignment with customer KPIs, SLAs, and service expectations.
* Create and maintain account-specific business plans outlining goals, risks, and opportunities; present insights and pipeline updates to branch leadership.
* Collaborate with sales, operations, and leadership to develop and execute customer growth strategies.
* Lead customer business reviews, presenting performance dashboards, KPI scorecards, and NFI’s value proposition.
* Manage pricing and rate negotiations leveraging market data and internal tools to competitively position NFI in the market.
* Develop, implement, and manage Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for assigned accounts to ensure operational consistency and customer satisfaction.
* Ensure all load activity is executed efficiently — monitoring service, follow-ups, and problem resolution.

* Use internal and industry tools to identify performance improvements, process optimization, and best practices.

* Strong understanding of DOT regulations, Hours of Service, and claims processes.

* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment handling multiple priorities and high communication volume.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Join our team as an Enterprise Technical Account Manager at Talon.One, where you'll play a key role in driving the success of our API-first promotion engine for our enterprise clients across the growing Americas region. You'll take ownership of the technical integration process, ensuring our platform fits seamlessly into each client's ecosystem. As the technical lead for your portfolio, you'll proactively monitor API usage, resolve recurring issues, and manage escalations in close collaboration with our Engineering and Customer Success teams.

You'll lead onboarding design, manage expectations, and deliver consistent value that boosts retention, growth, and satisfaction. In this strategic role, you'll also explore new tech partnerships and integration opportunities that expand our ecosystem and unlock more value for our customers.

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM:**

Our global team of 15+ Technical Account Managers is spread across the world, including EMEA, US, and APAC. We always strive for a seamless client onboarding and bug-free integration, while balancing ever-changing client requests on a daily basis. Our team works closely with Customer Success Managers and the development team, enabling us to act as consultants to all parties involved in the client onboarding journey. Ultimately, handling expectations related to the integration of our platform is where we drive value for our clients & our company.

Our team is defined by our commitment to mutual support and our dedication to deep problem-solving. These qualities are essential in future teammates in order for us to continue building on our strengths.

The estimated total compensation for this role is $115,500, though actual compensation may vary depending on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, certifications, and location. The salary range is subject to change and may be adjusted at any time. For this role, you must be located within commuting distance of one of our US hubs: New York, Chicago, San Francisco, or Boston.

  

**ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:**

* Own the end-to-end technical integration of our API-driven platform into each client's ecosystem
* Troubleshoot recurring technical issues and drive escalations through to resolution
* Manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts, tracking API usage to protect retention, growth, and satisfaction
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and Engineering to deliver a strong client experience
* Design and continuously improve customer onboarding processes
* Identify new technology partnerships and integration opportunities that expand our ecosystem
* Guide customers through expectation-setting conversations that build long-term trust
* Support escalated tickets alongside the broader support team

  

**WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:**

* 4+ years of previous experience working as a Technical Account Manager, Integrations Consultant, , or similar technical client-facing role
* Experience owning API integrations end-to-end for enterprise-level accounts
* Demonstrated ability to successfully handle the demands of Enterprise accounts, including complex stakeholder management
* Proven experience with SaaS based products
* High level of problem-solving attitude in a troubleshooting environment
* Excellent written communication skills with the ability to explain complex topics in easily understood and concise language to both technical and non-technical professionals
* Stay calm, patient, and professional while managing high-stakes customer relationships
* Analytical understanding with a high focus on data-driven decision-making

  

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Learning budget and LinkedIn Learning
* Competitive salaries & 401(k) plan w/match
* Medical, dental, & life insurance
* Flexible PTO
* Mental health support with Nilo.health

**WHY YOU SHOULD WORK FOR US:**

* **The right attitude:** modern methods and a diverse, creative workspace with an open and international culture
* **Everyone for the product:** Together we create a flexible, highly scalable product with state-of-the-art technologies. We can only succeed if everyone works as a team
* **Healthy Growth:** Growing our company means growing everyone in the team. We love to share knowledge and learn
* **A great environment:** Flexible and family-friendly environment, bright and easily accessible offices, modern software and hardware
* **High flexibility degree:** Prefer to work early or late at night? Do you have to pick up your children from kindergarten? Do you prefer working abroad? We believe in results and motivated employees

  

**Do you want this job?**

We'd love to hear from you! Apply directly via the form below.

We do not make employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religious belief, ethnic origin, nationality, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by company policy. As an employer we strive for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibit harassment of any kind.*

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
The Scale Marketing Account Manager serves as the lead point of contact for all account management matters, providing ongoing and proactive client service and acts as the internal champion of assigned accounts.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Maintain an in-depth knowledge of client business, current KPIs and historical activity
* Collaborate with lead Partner/Account Strategists to identify and grow new opportunities for assigned accounts
* Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders
* Anticipate problems/challenges and present ideas to address before they become performance issues
* Prepare reports on account performance prior to weekly/monthly client meetings
* Be the day-to-day contact for key client personnel, always ready to assist with challenging client requests or to escalate issues as needed
* Manage budgets and timelines, flagging any changes of scope with time and/or budget implications
* Work with finance team to provide ongoing financial coordination, media reconciliation, client invoicing and account tracking.
* Work with data team to forecast and track key assigned account metrics (e.g. monthly/quarterly sales results and annual forecasts)
* Collaborate with in-house creative team members to ensure projects are completed and in line with media launch dates.
* Be curious and forward-thinking, understanding trends with the ability to articulate how they will affect client business
* Be a pleaser without being a pushover.
* Collaborate on market/competitive research and landscape client business category
* Manage onboarding process for new clients (Marketing Services Agreements, AOR letters, credit applications, etc.)
* Participate in planning topline account strategy outlines including suggested media tactics, budget recommendations, target customer focus, etc.
* Own the scheduling of Internal Strategy Meetings & client strategy presentation meetings
* Build detailed strategy presentations with media buys and client presentation meeting agendas
* Work with Media Planner/Buyers to manage media RFPs and organize submissions for internal review; communicating with media vendors to refine proposals and identify new opportunities
* Obtain order acceptance, contract confirmation documents and airchecks/proof of performance from every media partner to ensure schedules are running properly
* Liaison with outside Media Vendors to ensure schedules run cleanly, make goods are processed, and demonstrates sound judgement when considering solutions to impression delivery challenges
* Own communication with Creative department for assigned accounts including submission of deliverables required and obtaining client approvals
* Own communication with Digital department for assigned accounts including dissemination of IOs, budget guidelines and campaign KPIs
* Other tasks as necessary for assigned clients to ensure excellent customer service

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years of client account management
* Agency side experience working with both traditional and digital media channels preferred
* Curiosity, Honesty, Integrity, Respect for Peers and the Process
* Ego-less: We all pitch in where needed to get the job done.
* We Treat Our Clients Businesses Like They Are Our Own

**About Scale**
---------------

Scale Marketing is a collective of professionals who bring unique business and media experience together to drive client success.

We dive into our client’s customer data and historic media buys to optimize strategy. We buy media strategically and efficiently, and we produce creative work designed to meet specific KPIs. With robust data and analytics expertise, Scale is constantly testing, analyzing, updating, and optimizing.

We attribute our success to the way we treat our clients and each other, and we are always looking for subject matter experts to join our team.

Proud to be awarded designation by Crain’s Chicago Business as one of the 2021 Best Places to Work in Chicago.

jobs.description:
At Verstela, we don't just fill jobs—we create success stories for the talent, clients and communities we serve.

Our guiding principle is simple: *we are successful when we help others become successful.*

Year after year, we're named to ClearlyRated's Best of Staffing list, a testament to our ongoing commitment to service excellence and customer satisfaction.

If you're energized by building relationships, opening doors, and turning a cold prospect into a real business conversation, this could be a great opportunity for you.

As a Market Sales Development Representative (SDR), you'll help drive growth for your local Verstela market by identifying prospective clients, starting conversations, and scheduling discovery meetings for our sales and branch leadership teams.

This is a highly active, outbound sales role. You'll spend your time making calls, connecting with prospects through email and LinkedIn, visiting businesses in person, and finding creative ways to build relationships. Success in this role comes from consistency, curiosity, resilience, and a willingness to do what it takes to get the conversation started.

  

**You will:**

* Prospect and identify new business opportunities within your assigned market.
* Initiate conversations with business leaders to schedule appointments for our branch teams.
* Visit prospective clients in person through regular market canvassing and drop-ins.
* Find creative ways to provide value and build relationships.
* Meet daily and weekly targets in a rewarding environment.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

Your primary focus is creating qualified opportunities for the local sales team. Success will be measured by your ability to consistently meet weekly new client appointment goals, generate strong prospect engagement, and schedule meetings that turn into meaningful sales conversations.

You'll also be expected to maintain consistent outbound activity and a strong discovery meeting show rate.

  

**What We Offer:**

* **Growth Opportunities:** Regular check-ins with your manager and a supportive team environment.
* **Steady Schedule:** Enjoy a stable Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm schedule.
* **Team Spirit:** Enjoy a supportive team atmosphere where individual and collective achievements are celebrated.
* **Full Benefits Package:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage, a Health Savings Account, virtual care, and life and long-term disability insurance.
* **Additional Perks:** Paid time off, office snacks, birthdays off, and paid community service time

**You have:**

* **Sales and/or Metrics Experience:** At least 1 year of experience in a metrics driven role (retail, hospitality, SDR or outbound sales are all encouraged to apply)
* **Go-Getter Attitude:** Eager to build rapport with prospective clients, call and drop-in to achieve goals.
* **Resilience:** You know it takes some "no's " to get to a yes
* **Tech Savviness:** Proficient in MS Word, and Outlook, and quick to learn new software.
* **Communication Pro:** Strong verbal and written communication skills to engage effectively with decision-makers.

  

**You'll Thrive Here If You Are:**

Competitive and goal-oriented, but also relationship-driven. Experience in prospecting, inside sales, business development, marketing, direct sales, or consulting.

jobs.title: Operations and Production Coordinator for Hearts of Mercy and Compassion
jobs.description:
Lutheran Church Charities is seeking a Project Manager for its Hearts of Mercy & Compassion Ministry to coordinate inventory, assembly, order fulfillment, shipping, vendor relationships, and volunteers. This hands-on role ensures ministry items are prepared accurately and delivered on time while supporting church affiliates and crisis response logistics. The ideal candidate is organized, collaborative, attentive to detail, and committed to LCC’s mission, with a willingness to share their Christian faith and compassion with those served.

**Position Summary**

HMC Operations and Production Coordinator manages the day-to-day operations of the Hearts of Mercy & Compassion (HMC) Ministry, with a focus on inventory, assembly, order fulfillment, shipping, vendor coordination, volunteers, and related logistics. This role ensures that hearts, fish, crosses, and supplies are ready and delivered on time to support ministry requests, church affiliates, and crisis response.

The person in this position must be committed to LCC’s mission and comfortable sharing their Christian faith to encourage and support those served.

**General Responsibilities**

**Inventory and Vendor Coordination**

* Maintain adequate inventory of hearts, fish, panels, crosses, hardware, paint, decals, packing materials, and other ministry supplies.
* Coordinate with vendors and ministry partners to order products and supplies, monitor delivery timelines, and address quality or availability concerns.
* Identify reliable vendors locally and nationally to support LCC and HMC church affiliates with HMC Director’s approval.
* Organize supplies and finished products so they are accessible and ready for assembly, fulfillment, and deployment.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and anticipate replenishment needs.

**Assembly, Fulfillment, and Shipping**

* Coordinate and participate in the building, painting, customization, and preparation of hearts and crosses using established ministry procedures.
* Schedule work to meet ministry requests and order deadlines.
* Confirm personalization details with requestors and ensure completed items are accurate and meet ministry quality standards.
* Maintain the HMC Parts Order System, including available products and pricing.
* Process affiliate orders, prepare packages, arrange shipping or delivery, and track fulfillment.
* Coordinate Cricut files, supplies, and use for ministry customization.

**Volunteer Coordination**

* Recruit and schedule daily volunteers for special projects when necessary, and support volunteers assisting with building, machining, painting, customization, packing, and related projects.
* Match volunteer assignments to individual abilities and provide clear instructions, materials, and support.
* Coordinate with HMC affiliate teams, who prepare ministry items off-site, ensuring they have the necessary supplies and understand expectations.
* Review completed work for consistency and quality.
* Record volunteer participation in designated software.

**Affiliate Support and Training**

* Serve as a resource for church affiliates regarding supplies, ordering, assembly, customization, and ministry procedures.
* Assist in new affiliate training with HMC Director using established materials and hands-on instruction.
* Keep assembly instructions, painting guides, personalization resources, the Affiliate Manual, and training materials current.
* Assist with creating videos for online affiliate training.
* Support the growth of HMC church affiliates and volunteer and vendor partnerships nationally.

**Ministry Logistics and Crisis Response**

* Coordinate deliveries of hearts and crosses and provide a compassionate ministry presence when delivering items in person.
* Serve as operational backup to the HMC Director in coordinating crisis deployments, including supplies, transportation, placement, setup, and volunteer participation.
* Partner with other LCC ministries on joint deployments and visits.
* Participate in deployments as needed.
* May be asked to represent LCC and HMC at conferences, events, and presentations.

**Records and Operational Support**

* Maintain accurate records of item numbering, inventory, orders, volunteer engagement, and ministry giftings in designated software.
* Identify practical improvements to organization, assembly, packing, and fulfillment processes.
* Work with the Director to coordinate supplies, vendors, and logistics for new ministry items or tools.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Strong organizational skills, including planning, scheduling, recordkeeping, and follow-through.
* Experience coordinating projects, inventory, orders, shipping, volunteers, or similar operations.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and adjust priorities as ministry needs change.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with staff, volunteers, vendors, and church affiliates.
* A collaborative approach to supporting HMC and other LCC ministries.
* Attention to detail and a commitment to accurate orders and quality work.
* Ability to solve problems and make thoughtful decisions, including during crisis response.
* Willingness to participate in hands-on assembly, packing, and preparation of ministry items using established instructions.
* Comfort sharing Christian faith and providing a compassionate ministry presence.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Outlook, Teams, and the ability to learn inventory and ministry tracking software.
* Experience with volunteer coordination, order fulfillment, or shipping preferred.
* Familiarity with Cricut equipment or similar customization tools helpful; willingness to learn is essential.

**Disclaimer**

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required.

Benefits:

The Community Clinic Association of Los Angeles County (CCALAC) is a non-profit membership organization that provides a wide variety of essential services to community health centers that serve the Los Angeles region. CCALAC represents 68 community health center organizations that provide comprehensive primary, dental and behavioral health services throughout Los Angeles County. Health centers in Los Angeles serve 2.18 million patients annually regardless of ability to pay. These organizations include private, non-profit, Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), and community health centers.

Reporting to the Communications Manager, the Communications Coordinator is responsible for activities that support CCALAC’s communications strategy. Since 1977, Cinelease has supported the film and television industry with lighting and grip equipment, production services, and studio facilities. Our reputation is built on exceptional service, industry expertise, and a commitment to helping productions succeed.

We are looking for a creative, organized Marketing & Social Media Manager to bring the Cinelease story to life through compelling content, thoughtful design, and engaging digital campaigns.

**About the Role**

The Marketing & Social Media Manager will manage Cinelease’s social media presence, develop campaign concepts, and create marketing assets that strengthen

brand awareness and customer engagement across our divisions. Working closely with marketing leadership, project directors, and internal teams, you will

translate business priorities into clear messaging and effective creative work. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys both developing ideas and bringing them to life.

An initial priority will be evaluating Cinelease’s social media channels and implementing a coordinated plan to improve content quality, brand consistency, and audience engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Social Media Management**

* Own the social content calendar and day-to-day publishing, aligning content with company initiatives, services, events, and relevant industry conversations.
* Write and publish content tailored to each platform, manage community engagement, and connect customer inquiries with the appropriate teams.
* Monitor channel performance, audience insights, and emerging trends to recommend improvements and report on reach, engagement, website traffic, and

relevant inquiries.

**Creative Content & Campaign Management**

* Develop campaign concepts and stories that showcase Cinelease’s people, equipment, facilities, and services while supporting the broader brand strategy.
* Capture and edit photography and video, and create graphics for digital campaigns, sales materials, merchandise, and internal communications.
* Manage assigned creative projects from concept through publication, collaborating with internal teams and outside partners to coordinate priorities,

timelines, feedback, and approvals.

* Maintain consistent messaging and design across divisions and channels, including creative support for website updates and customer-facing digital

initiatives.

* Organize creative assets and ensure published content is accurate, approved, and respectful of usage permissions and production confidentiality.

* At least three years of relevant experience in marketing, social media management, creative content production, or a related field.
* A portfolio demonstrating graphic design, photography, video editing, and social media content, with a clear explanation of your contribution.
* Experience managing business social media accounts and using publishing and analytics tools to guide improvements.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud or comparable design, photo editing, and video production tools.
* Practical knowledge of camera operation, lighting, audio capture, composition, and editing.
* Strong writing, proofreading, organization, and project management skills.
* Sound creative judgment and the ability to manage overlapping deadlines, incorporate feedback, and collaborate across teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with film and television production, equipment rental, studio operations, or related business-to-business services.
* Experience supporting multiple locations, divisions, or brands.
* Motion graphics, basic animation, paid social campaign support, or website content management experience.
* A degree in marketing, communications, graphic design, film, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success means a consistent, engaging social media presence; creative work that clearly communicates Cinelease’s capabilities; reliable campaign delivery; and measurable improvements in audience engagement and relevant customer interest. You will help establish an efficient creative workflow that supports planned campaigns and timely opportunities.

**Why Cinelease**

This role offers the opportunity to shape how Cinelease’s people, expertise, and services are represented across its marketing channels. You will collaborate with teams supporting film and television production and see your ideas become content used throughout the business.

### **B2B-SMB Outside Sales Representative (1099 + Monthly Stipend)** **Job Summary**

We are looking for an enterprising, self-starting individual to join our team as a **B2B-SMB Outside Sales Representative**. As part of our field sales development team, you will recognize, prospect, and cultivate potential SMB (small and medium-sized business) sales leads, travel to meet directly with business owners and executive decision-makers face-to-face, and endeavor to transform initial sales conversations into lasting, high-value client relationships. Operating within your assigned local territory, you will promote WeLink's next-generation wireless fiber-like internet solutions as a superior, cost-effective alternative to traditional cable and telecom providers. You will leverage your expertise in direct sales, door-to-door prospecting, territory management, and consultative selling to demonstrate how WeLink's telecom technology optimizes business connectivity and improves their bottom line.

### **Outside Sales Representative Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Territory & Field Prospecting:** Travel daily within your designated sales territory to initiate cold visits, build boots-on-the-ground lead pipelines, and meet face-to-face with SMB decision-makers.
* **Consultative Product Presentation:** Maintain comprehensive, expert-level knowledge of WeLink's high-speed internet products, telecom infrastructure, and cloud connectivity services to effectively differentiate our solutions from incumbent providers.
* **Pipeline & CRM Management:** Rigorously manage, track, and update all sales leads, account activities, funnel stages, and closed deals within our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform.
* **Consultative Deal Closing:** Conduct professional needs assessments, overcome client objections, present tailored business proposals, and utilize proven closing strategies to meet or exceed monthly revenue targets.
* **Relationship Building & Post-Sale Support:** Coordinate with sales leadership and operational installation teams to ensure seamless onboarding, maintaining ongoing client touchpoints to realize cross-selling and referral opportunities.

### **Outside Sales Representative Requirements and Qualifications**

* **Sales & Industry Experience:** Proven track record in B2B sales, field sales, outside sales, business development, telecommunications, account management, or technology sales (prior experience selling SMB or MDU telecom solutions is a major plus).
* **Self-Motivated & Entrepreneurial:** A strong self-starting personality with an entrepreneurial spirit, high competitiveness, and the discipline to manage your own territory and schedule without constant supervision.
* **Communication & Negotiation:** Articulate, polished, and persuasive communication skills with a proven ability to establish instant credibility with executives and business owners.
* **Sales Methodology & Tools:** Deep understanding of full-cycle sales techniques, lead generation, sales funnel management, and proficiency with standard CRM software.
* **Mobility Requirements:** Valid driver's license, clean driving record, and reliable personal transportation to navigate your daily field territory. High school diploma or equivalent required.

### **What We Offer**

* **Uncapped 1099 Commission:** Six-figure earning potential directly tied to your performance with an aggressive, uncapped commission structure.
* **90-Day Ramp-Up Support:** A guaranteed **$2,000/month stipend** for your first 90 days of employment to support you as you establish your pipeline and launch your territory.

The position also coordinates departmental Grand Rounds and M&M conferences, fellowship and residency didactic activities, and fellowship moonlighting operations.

This is a full-time, hybrid position requiring four days onsite and one day offsite. Work locations include Parnassus, Mission Bay, and Mt. Zion. StreamU is hiring a Host / Production Coordinator to be both an on-camera presence and the connective tissue between StreamU and the people we work with. and athletes always know what’s next — while relaying their needs back to the production team  
internally. If you’re organized, comfortable on camera, and a natural communicator, this role sits  
right at the center of everything StreamU does.

encouraged to apply.

  activations, and keep StreamU’s voice consistent everywhere it shows up.

  schedules and talking points, and help the run of show come together across athletes and university partners.

Athlete Clients — comms & scheduling  
Internal Comms — relay & align  
Production — run of show
